title: Consultor(A) Funcional Salesforce - Pleno
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Consultor(A) Funcional Salesforce - Pleno em feira de santana. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

Consultor(a) Funcional Salesforce (Sales & Service Cloud) A jornada de quem ama repensar o futuro está aqui. Sobre a Rethink Somos uma consultoria que une tecnologia, design e estratégia de produtos digitais para solucionar os desafios de grandes empresas brasileiras. Agora como parte da Framework Digital, ampliamos nosso impacto atuando de ponta a ponta na jornada digital, da concepção à escala. Nossa missão é gerar valor real por meio de soluções que conectam times, sistemas e pessoas. Acreditamos que a transformação digital acontece quando estratégia, tecnologia e experiência andam juntas e é isso que entregamos. Empresas como Smiles, Gol, Santander Esfera, Swift e Comgás confiam em nossa parceria para acelerar sua evolução digital com consistência e resultado. Diversidade e Inclusão Para repensar o futuro, é essencial garantir ambientes mais diversos e inclusivos. Por isso, incentivamos fortemente a candidatura de mulheres, pessoas pretas, pardas, indígenas, LGBTQIAPN+ e pessoas com deficiência. Que tal repensar um futuro mais diverso com a gente? Qual será o seu papel? Como consultor Funcional, você atuará como Key User funcional especializado em Salesforce Sales Cloud e Service Cloud, sendo a ponte entre o time comercial (vendas e atendimento) e as áreas técnicas de TI. Seu principal objetivo é garantir a correta utilização da plataforma, aumentar a produtividade dos usuários, traduzir necessidades de negócio em requisitos funcionais e apoiar a evolução contínua dos processos de CRM, sempre com foco na experiência do cliente e na eficiência operacional. Como será seu dia a dia? Apoiar usuários comerciais no uso diário do Salesforce, tirando dúvidas, resolvendo problemas de navegação e promovendo boas práticas. Executar atividades operacionais relacionadas a processos de vendas (ex.: criação e acompanhamento de oportunidades, leads, contratos) e atendimento (casos, resolução de solicitações). Detalhar requisitos de negócio junto aos times de vendas, marketing e serviços, transformando demandas em especificações funcionais claras para o time técnico. Validar soluções funcionais antes da liberação em produção, realizando testes de aceitação (UAT) em Sales Cloud e Service Cloud. Homologar novas funcionalidades, fluxos e relatórios, garantindo que atendam aos critérios de negócio e qualidade. Identificar gargalos e melhorias nos processos comerciais e de relacionamento com clientes, propondo ajustes na configuração ou no uso do sistema. Participar de rituais ágeis (daily, review, planning) com o time de CRM, trazendo a visão do negócio. Criar e manter documentação de suporte, manuais e treinamentos para usuários finais. Para esta vaga, é essencial: Experiência prática comprovada em Salesforce Sales Cloud e Service Cloud (mínimo 2 anos atuando como key user, analista funcional ou consultor). Conhecimento sólido de processos de vendas, CRM e atendimento ao cliente (ex.: ciclo de leads, oportunidades, casos, SLAs). Capacidade de traduzir necessidades de negócio em requisitos funcionais claros e testáveis. Boa comunicação verbal e escrita para interagir com usuários negócio e times técnicos. Visão de processo e pensamento analítico para identificar melhorias e resolver problemas. Perfil colaborativo, paciente e didático para treinar e apoiar usuários com diferentes níveis de maturidade digital. Você pode se destacar se: Possuir certificações Salesforce, como Salesforce Certified Administrator ou Sales Cloud Consultant / Service Cloud Consultant. Tiver experiência com configurações básicas na plataforma (criação de campos, objetos, perfis, fluxos de aprovação, relatórios e dashboards). Demonstrar conhecimento em ferramentas de automação (Flow, Process Builder) ou integrações (API, middleware). Já tiver atuado em projetos de implantação ou migração de CRM. Apresentar familiaridade com métricas comerciais (funnel de vendas, tempo médio de resposta, NPS, etc.) e capacidade de criar KPIs no Salesforce. Ter experiência em setores regulados (financeiro, utilities, telecom) que exigem governança e rastreabilidade. Mostrar proatividade na gestão de mudanças e no treinamento de novos usuários (produção de materiais e workshops). Curtiu a oportunidade? Então, vem repensar o futuro com a gente! ✨

title: Gestor(A) De Contas
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Gestor(A) De Contas em feira de santana. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

Gestor(a) de Contas – Marketplace & Performance Somos uma empresa especializada em estratégia, operação e crescimento de e-commerces e marketplaces, com forte atuação orientada a dados, tecnologia e performance. Buscamos um(a) Gestor(a) de Contas para atuar de forma estratégica, sendo responsável pela operação e pelos resultados dos clientes. Essa posição exige visão analítica, senso de dono e capacidade de integrar estoque, tráfego, campanhas e performance comercial em diferentes marketplaces. title: Oracle Pcm Architect
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Oracle Pcm Architect em feira de santana. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

About Auxis Auxis is a U.S.-founded consulting and business outsourcing firm (est. 1997) that helps organizations optimize and transform their operations. We specialize in areas such as technology, finance, human resources, automation, and digital transformation. About the Role We are looking for an experienced Oracle PCM Architect to lead the design, implementation, and optimization of profitability and cost management solutions within the Oracle EPM Cloud ecosystem. This role requires a strong mix of functional finance knowledge + technical EPM expertise, with ownership over solution architecture and client-facing delivery. Key Responsibilities Lead end-to-end solution design and architecture for Oracle PCM implementations Define cost allocation models, driver-based costing, and profitability frameworks Work closely with finance stakeholders to translate business requirements into scalable solutions Oversee data integrations, calculations, and model performance optimization Ensure best practices in metadata design, hierarchies, and dimensional modeling Support and guide teams during month-end and planning cycles Troubleshoot complex issues across data, calculations, and reporting Act as a technical leader and mentor for junior team members Required Qualifications Bachelor’s degree in Finance, Accounting, Information Systems, or related field 5+ years of experience with Oracle EPM, including strong exposure to PCM Strong understanding of: Cost allocation methodologies Profitability analysis frameworks Financial modeling and reporting Hands-on experience with: Oracle PCMCS / EPCM Smart View Data Integration / Data Management Metadata and hierarchy design Preferred Qualifications Experience in consulting or managed services environments Exposure to multi-client / multi-project delivery Oracle EPM certifications (nice to have) Soft Skills Strong problem-solving and analytical mindset Ability to communicate with both technical and finance stakeholders Comfortable working in a fast-paced, deadline-driven environment Work Expectations Support North American business hours when required Flexibility during planning and financial cycles Ownership of delivery quality and SLAs

title: Designer De Apresentações (Pleno/Sênior) - Banco De Talentos
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Designer De Apresentações (Pleno/Sênior) - Banco De Talentos em feira de santana. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar. Quem somos: A Studio Rx é uma empresa de produção global digital, criada para as necessidades exclusivas das marcas de saúde. Como Hub de produção da IPG Health, o Studio RX apoia a rede global de agências do grupo, tendo como pilares principais a qualidade e eficiência. O que buscamos: Estamos em busca de um Designer de Apresentações com forte experiência em criação de layouts, templates e narrativas visuais, capaz de seguir guidelines de marca com excelência estética e transformar conteúdos complexos, incluindo materiais médicos e científicos, em apresentações claras, estratégicas e visualmente atraentes. Procuramos um profissional com domínio de Design da Informação e Visualização de Dados, olhar apurado para hierarquia visual, acessibilidade e storytelling, habilidade para resolver problemas de design com agilidade e interesse constante por novas tendências e ferramentas inovadoras. Inglês fluente é mandatório pois trabalhamos em projetos internacionais com times globais. Responsabilidades: Desenvolver apresentações estratégicas, dinâmicas e visualmente sofisticadas, garantindo consistência com as diretrizes de marca, excelência estética e adaptação para diferentes formatos e dispositivos (desktop, tablet e mobile);
Atuar em reuniões de briefing e colaborar diretamente com stakeholders para transformar informações complexas em storytelling claros, objetivos e visualmente impactantes;
Trabalhar com materiais médicos e científicos, assegurando alto nível de precisão, atenção a detalhes e tratamento adequado de dados, além de transformar conteúdos técnicos e densos em apresentações visualmente atraentes, organizadas e de fácil compreensão;
Gerenciar o processo de desenvolvimento de apresentações do início ao fim, incluindo alinhamento com stakeholders, construção da narrativa, criação de layouts, incorporação de feedbacks e cumprimento de prazos;
Ser responsável pela revisão final e controle de qualidade das apresentações antes do compartilhamento, assegurando clareza, consistência visual e precisão das informações;
Trabalhar de forma independente ou colaborativa com outros designers, gerenciando múltiplos projetos simultaneamente e mantendo alta performance em ambientes de ritmo acelerado. Requerimentos & Skills: Experiência mínima de 4 anos em Design de Apresentações, com formação superior (bacharelado) em Design, Artes Visuais ou áreas correlatas;
Domínio avançado de ferramentas de apresentação, incluindo PowerPoint, Google Slides, Keynote e Prezi, além de proficiência em ferramentas essenciais do dia a dia, como Word e Excel, para organização, edição e estruturação de conteúdos e dados Possuir conhecimento sólido em Design da Informação e Visualização de Dados, sendo capaz de transformar dados complexos em gráficos, dashboards, mapas e infográficos claros, estratégicos e visualmente atraentes. Espera-se domínio de hierarquia visual, organização da informação, escolha adequada de visualizações, simplificação de conteúdos densos e capacidade de comunicar insights de forma intuitiva para diferentes públicos. Conhecimento em animação e construção de apresentações interativas, utilizando transições e motion design para criar narrativas visuais fluidas, dinâmicas e envolventes Conhecimento em ferramentas de design e edição visual, como Adobe Creative Suite (Photoshop, Illustrator e InDesign) e/ou Figma, para criação e refinamento de assets gráficos, layouts e materiais de apoio Conhecimento de ferramentas de inteligência artificial (IA) aplicadas à automação e otimização de processos criativos, como Microsoft Copilot, Gemini, Claude, Gamma, Adobe Firefly e recursos de IA integrados ao Photoshop Forte repertório em design gráfico, com domínio de tipografia, teoria das cores, hierarquia visual, contraste, grids/alinhamentos e princípios de composição, além de olhar apurado para criar materiais limpos, sofisticados e profissionais;
Excelentes habilidadesde comunicação, colaboração e gerenciamento de projetos, com capacidade para atuar em múltiplas demandas simultaneamente;
Inglês avançado/fluente. Está preparado(a) para cultivar novas experiências em um time que joga junto e valoriza o melhor de cada um(a)? #VEMSERSTUDIORX

title: Arte Finalista (Pleno/Sênior)- Banco De Talentos
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Arte Finalista (Pleno/Sênior)- Banco De Talentos em camaçari. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar. Quem somos: A Studio Rx é uma empresa de produção global digital, criada para as necessidades exclusivas das marcas de saúde. Como Hub de produção da IPG Health, o Studio RX apoia a rede global de agências do grupo, tendo como pilares principais a qualidade e eficiência. O que buscamos: Estamos em busca de um arte-finalista capaz de trabalhar com rapidez, eficiência e mantendo grande atenção aos detalhes. O profissional deve ser altamente organizado e conseguir trabalhar em mais de um projeto ao mesmo tempo. Entre as atividades, a principal será fazer ajustes e alterações de cor, formato, texto, imagens e preparação dos arquivos para impressão (com sangria, marcas de corte e ficha técnica). O candidato precisa ter um conhecimento avançado no Adobe InDesign já que 95% do trabalho será feito nele, e o nível de inglês para escrita e interpretação de texto também precisa ser avançado. Além disso, será necessário também montar facas especiais e fazer o envio dos arquivos para a gráfica. Num primeiro momento o profissional estará sob supervisão para garantir o entendimento e fluxo de funcionamento do estúdio, mas com o passar do tempo a idéia é ganhar autonomia para realizar as tarefas mais cotidianas e recorrentes sem muita supervisão. Pré-Requisitos: Experiência comprovada no segmento impresso e em todos os detalhes que o meio exige (marcas de corte, sangría, margens de segurança, dobras, vinco, cores CMYK, facas especiais, e fichas técnicas);
Graduação em Design Gráfico, Desenho Industrial ou áreas correlatas. Experiência de pelo menos 5+ anos na função como designer gráfico no ramo impresso. Domínio dos software InDesign e illustrator;
Inglês avançado (com comprovação via teste ao vivo na segunda etapa do processo);
Disponibilidade para trabalhar das 10h as 19h ou das 13h as 22h. Será um diferencial se você tiver: Ter atuado ativamente com fechamento de arquivos, arte-final e preparação de arquivos para impressão. Conhecimento em softwares de gestão de tarefas como Monday ou Trello (aqui utilizamos WorkFront);
Está preparado(a) para cultivar novas experiências em um time que joga junto e valoriza o melhor de cada um(a)? #VEMSERSTUDIORX -- Consideramos todas as aplicações para nossas vagas sem distinção de gênero, orientação sexual, etnia, cultura, origem, religião, deficiência, idade etc. Acreditamos na construção de um mundo mais diverso, com mais representatividade e livre de preconceitos. Aqui você encontra um ambiente diverso, colaborativo e inclusivo que promove o desenvolvimento por meio das conexões humanas!

title: Médico Endocrinologista
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Médico Endocrinologista em feira de santana. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar. *OPORTUNIDADE PARA MÉDICO ENDOCRINOLOGISTA (com RQE) NA TELADOC HEALTH\ " Junte-se à Nossa Equipe de Saúde Digital! A Teladoc Health, líder global em saúde digital e inovação em cuidados de saúde, está buscando Médicas e Médicos Especialistas em Endocrinologia! Se você é um profissional comprometido com a excelência no atendimento ao paciente e deseja fazer parte de uma revolução na prestação de serviços de saúde, esta é a oportunidade que você estava esperando. *SOBRE A TELADOC HEALTH: * A Teladoc Health está na vanguarda da transformação da saúde, oferecendo acesso rápido, conveniente e confiável a serviços de saúde através de nossa plataforma digital. Nossa missão é tornar o cuidado de saúde acessível a todos, em qualquer lugar e a qualquer momento. Combinando tecnologia de ponta e conhecimento médico, estamos moldando o futuro da saúde e proporcionando impacto positivo na vida de milhões de pessoas. *O QUE PROCURAMOS: * Você será responsável por realizar consultas por vídeo e telefone, por intermédio de plataforma do empregador, atendendo na modalidade de consultas de especialidade em Endocrinologia, de forma ética, com abordagem biopsicossocial do processo saúde-adoecimento, integrando ações de prevenção, promoção, proteção, recuperação e educação em saúde buscando alcançar os melhores resultados clínicos;
DESCRIÇÃO DAS ATIVIDADES: Fornecer atendimento médico especializado em Endocrinologia de forma remota, através de consultas e avaliações realizadas por meio de plataformas digitais de comunicação. Experiência e conhecimento para o diagnóstico, tratamento e acompanhamento de pacientes com doenças e distúrbios Endocrinológicos. Realizar consultas em Telemedicina sendo capaz de conduzir anamnese virtual para coletar queixas e histórico médico, realizar exame clínico e avaliações à distância, interpretar resultados de exames laboratoriais e de imagem, elaborar diagnósticos precisos, propor medidas terapêuticas e orientações de cuidado, reconhecer sinais de risco e gravidade em Endocrinologia e critérios para encaminhar ao atendimento presencial. Atuar de forma a priorizar a prática médica centrada na pessoa. Elaborar planos de tratamento individualizados, levando em consideração as necessidades específicas de cada paciente. Ser hábil na prescrição de medicamentos adequados para tratar doenças Endocrinológicas. Monitorar o progresso dos pacientes ao longo do tratamento em telemedicina. Realizar ajustes no plano de tratamento, conforme necessário, com base na resposta do paciente ao tratamento. Desenvolver atividades integrais de saúde, incorporando prevenção e promoção de saúde para dar as respostas mais adequadas às necessidades de saúde apresentadas. Atender com elevado grau de qualidade, sendo resolutivo na grande maioria das orientações acerca dos principais problemas de saúde em Endocrinologia. Considerar os valores e preferências pessoais do paciente conjuntamente às melhores evidências científicas e à experiência de manejo clínico para efetivamente promover a melhor prática clínica e os melhores desfechos em saúde para cada indivíduo. Exercer uso racional de recursos em saúde visando a segurança do paciente e a prevenção quaternária, evitando sobrediagnóstico e sobretratamento, que expõe os indivíduos a maiores riscos do que benefícios em saúde. Estimular a participação e a autonomia dos indivíduos e familiares, fortalecendo a aderência a tratamentos e medidas de autocuidado. Documentar todas as interações e informações relevantes dos pacientes em prontuários eletrônicos seguros e confidenciais. Ter capacidade de crítica de sua própria atividade médica, considerando-a em seus aspectos científicos, éticos e sociais para aprimoramento contínuo. Manter-se bem-informado e atualizado, ampliando sua própria competência em relação a conhecimentos sobre riscos em saúde e sobre as medidas mais eficientes para eliminar ou reduzir os riscos relevantes. Respeitar, cumprir e fazer cumprir os ditames do Código de Ética Médica, bem como a Legislação vigente e os regulamentos internos formais da Instituição. REQUISITOS Formação Acadêmica: Obrigatório: GRADUAÇÃO EM MEDICINA RESIDÊNCIA MÉDICA OU ESPECIALIZAÇÃO EM ENDOCRINOLOGIA. Certificações: Registro ativo no Conselho Regional de Medicina (CRM);
Certificado deTítulo de Especialista - RQE (emitido pelo Conselho respectivo) em Endocrinologia. Certificado Digital Ativo reconhecido pela Infraestrutura de Chaves Públicas Brasileira (ICP-Brasil). Experiência: Experiência em atividades relacionadas à atuação em atendimento médico em Endocrinologia, sendo desejável experiência prévia em Telemedicina e Atenção Primária à Saúde;
Conhecimentos Específicos para a função: Prestar orientações personalizadas a indivíduos e suas famílias com conhecimentos para o diagnóstico, tratamento e acompanhamento de pacientes com doenças e distúrbios Endócrinos e metabólicos.. Competências Comportamentais: Comprometimento com os pacientes, com ideais e valores da empresa, apresentando postura ética, pontualidade, capacidade de integração com equipe multiprofissional. Outros Requisitos Importantes: Conhecimentos e Habilidades em computação: uso do Pacote Office (Excel, Word, Power Point, Gráficos) e Internet. Familiaridade com tecnologias de telemedicina e uso de plataformas de comunicação virtual é um diferencial desejável. Local de Trabalho: REMOTO IMPORTANTE: MODELO DE CONTRATAÇÃO: Contratação em regime de Prestador de Serviços por contrato Pessoa Jurídica, necessário fazer parte como representante legal ou sócio de um CNPJ ativo. REMUNERAÇÃO E AGENDAMENTOS : a negociar durante processo seletivo. Esta descrição de cargo/atuação tem caráter informativo e pode ser ajustada conforme a necessidade da empresa ou instituição que oferece a oportunidade de trabalho em telemedicina para Médico Clínico/Generalista Residente em Endocrinologia.

title: Arquitetura De Segurança Cloud Aws - 132141
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Arquitetura De Segurança Cloud Aws - 132141 em feira de santana. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar. O que buscamos: Profissional de nível Arquitetura que atue com (Segurança/AWS). Responsabilidades: Arquiteto especializado em segurança para ambientes financeiros críticos, responsável por definir, validar e garantir controles de segurança fim a fim para cargas de trabalho relacionadas ao PIX na AWS, incluindo integração híbrida com ambientes on-premises, HSM e requisitos regulatórios. Realização de comprovações (POCs) para migração de workloads PIX do mainframe para AWS. Definir arquitetura de segurança alinhada ao AWS Well-Architected Framework (Pilar de Segurança);
Projetar estratégia deIAM (federação, RBAC, privilégio mínimo);
Definir estratégia de criptografia (em trânsito e em repouso);
Integrar soluções HSM (on-prem e cloud);
Garantir conformidade com requisitos do BACEN e LGPD;
Definir padrões de segurança para containers (EKS/ROSA);
Implementar estratégiade segurança multi-conta e landing zone;
Conduzir modelagem de ameaças e avaliações de risco;
Apoiar POCs com validação de segurança e verificações de conformidade. Requisitos : AWS IAM, AWS KMS, AWS CloudHSM;
Criptografia (PKI, TLS, assinaturas digitais);
Segurança de APIs (OAuth2, OpenID Connect);
Segurança de containers e Kubernetes;

Role Overview We are looking for an LP Partnership Manager to drive business development and build strong relationships with liquidity providers across key regions. The ideal candidate is highly connected within the local market, with a strong network of liquidity providers and a deep understanding of regional payment and banking landscapes. Key Responsibilities Business Development & Partnerships Identify, source, and establish relationships with local and regional liquidity providers Evaluate LP quality (pricing, depth, reliability, regions covered) Negotiate trading terms (spreads, fees, credit lines, margin terms) Market & Network Development Leverage existing network to expand LP coverage in key regions (APAC, LATAM, Africa) Maintain strong relationships with banks, payment providers, and liquidity partners Stay up to date with local market dynamics, pricing trends, and competitive landscape Execution & Collaboration Work closely with traders to ensure optimal liquidity, pricing, and execution quality Coordinate with internal teams to onboard LPs and ensure smooth operational setup Support ongoing performance monitoring and optimization of LP relationships Banking & Infrastructure Setup Facilitate opening of bank accounts and payment rails required for LP operations Identify suitable partners to support local currency flows and settlement Requirements 5 to 10 years of experience in business development, partnerships, or liquidity management Strong experience in payments, FX, trading, or related financial services Well connected with liquidity providers, banks, and payment partners Proven ability to source and onboard LPs in local markets Strong understanding of regional market structures and liquidity dynamics Must have strong, deep LP network in at least one of the following regions: LATAM Vision & Mission OSL is the first SFC-licensed digital asset platform in Hong Kong and a PayFi innovator. Through stablecoin payments, cross-border settlement and global licensing, we are building the next-generation payments network. Stablecoins have become everyday money across emerging markets and are widely viewed as blockchain’s “killer app,” with industry focus shifting from token issuance to real-world consumer and enterprise payment adoption. The strongest growth lies in cross-border B2B payments, where providers embedding stablecoins into corporate settlement flows can capture significant volume and float. Long-term defensibility comes from regulatory licences, banking partners and cross-border corridors. OSL holds or has acquired licences in Hong Kong, Japan, Australia, Bermuda and Indonesia, and is expanding into Europe, Brazil, Southeast Asia and Africa through acquisitions and licence applications. With OSL Pay and StableX, we embed stablecoin settlement into bank accounts and card networks, support 150+ digital assets, and provide 24/7 fiat–stablecoin conversion. As a regulated pioneer with a startup mindset, we believe the future of payments will be driven by real adoption and scalable deployment, not technology narratives. We welcome builders who are passionate about crypto and payments to join us in shaping compliant, global payment infrastructure.

Drive for Results: Relentless focus on delivering incremental value and ensuring release readiness in a fast‑moving environment. Be fully aligned with our core values: Think Big - Be courageous and bold. Aspire to greatness. Relentlessly pursue market innovation. Set the standard by which others follow. Create solutions that have a meaningful impact. Solve the challenges our customers don’t know they have. Be Curious - Be a lifelong learner. Seek out new ideas to serve customers. Celebrate diverse perspectives. Listen. Build connections and belonging. Act with integrity. Give back. One Syniti family. Our client is a fast-growing proptech startup specializing in the digital management of vacation homes located outside major urban centers. They offer a\ "full-service\" solution thatallows property owners to focus on hospitality while we optimize visibility, occupancy rates, and profits. Founded in Italy, where we are leaders in the sector, they are now rapidly expanding into the US market as well. Our approach combines cutting-edge technology with a vision of sustainable tourism.

Their approach blends advanced technology with a vision of sustainable tourism. Some highlights:

  • #1 on Trustpilot in property management
  • Italy's leading startup, growing fast
  • Over 600 listings managed across Italy and the United States
  • 188 international investors by our side
  • Team of 30 professionals, average age 29

We are looking for a new full-time colleague to join their team remotely. The ideal candidate must be fluent in both English and Italian.

The role requires a weekly commitment of 40 hours, including availability on Saturdays and Sundays from 7:00 AM to 11:00 PM (UTC-5 / UTC-6 time zone). We are looking for someone with flexible hours, including availability to work on weekends and public holidays.

About the Role:

As a Digital Receptionist, you will be the driving force behind guest satisfaction and operational excellence. You will manage multi-channel support, assist travelers throughout the entire booking process, and ensure that the owners of our properties receive the highest level of communication.

We are looking for someone who goes beyond simply answering questions — someone who proactively identifies new solutions to improve our processes. If you are ready to become an enthusiastic ambassador for the client, this is the role for you.

Key Responsibilities:

  • Manage and resolve customer inquiries via channels such as email, chat, and phone.
  • Provide assistance to travelers at every stage of the booking process.
  • Maintain effective communication with property owners, ensuring their needs are met.
  • Identify upselling opportunities during customer interactions.
  • Collaborate with the team to identify and propose improvements in customer service.
  • Perform other miscellaneous tasks requested by the company and relevant to the role.
  • Be an enthusiastic ambassador for the client in every interaction.

Requirements:

  • Great experience in Hospitality Industry-MUST HAVE
  • Multichannel customer support (email, chat, and phone) – Advanced
  • Clear and professional written and verbal communication – Advanced
  • Problem-solving under pressure while maintaining calm and professionalism – Advanced
  • Ability to explain complex concepts in simple, accessible terms – Intermediate to Advanced
  • Self-organized, autonomous, and proactive work style – Advanced
  • Full fluency in both **English and Italian** (spoken and written) – Advanced (both are required)
  • Comfortable working independently in a startup environment with a strong sense of ownership and a team-first mindset

Nice to Have Skills:

  • Experience in hospitality, property management, or proptech – Intermediate
  • Familiarity with Airbnb and similar OTA platforms – Intermediate
  • CRM experience, specifically Monday.Com – Basic to Intermediate
  • Upselling and client relationship management skills – Intermediate

Tools & Platforms:

  • Monday.Com (CRM) – a plus
  • Email and chat support platforms
  • Google Workspace
  • Airbnb and OTA platforms (familiarity preferred)

You Are the Right Fit If:

  • You communicate clearly: in a clear, direct, and concise manner, both in writing and verbally.
  • You are able to find quick, practical solutions while remaining calm and professional.
  • You have the ability to explain complex concepts in simple terms.
  • You thrive in a startup environment: strong sense of ownership, ability to manage ambiguity, and a team-oriented mindset.
  • You work independently and in an organized manner, prioritizing tasks with the greatest impact.
  • Bonus: Experience in hospitality, property management, or proptech;
    familiarity with Airbnband similar platforms;
    proficiency with CRM tools (Monday.Com);
    being bilingual in English/Italian is considered a plus.
  • If you agree with the compensation of $1,000–$1,500/month
  • If you have a bachelors degree related.
  • If you agree with the next schedule split:

This role has a non-standard schedule. Its on EST timezone, so please consider the time difference from your country.(

You will work a split shift:

— Morning block: 9:00 AM – 1:00 PM ET

— Evening block: 6:00 PM – 10:00 PM ET

— 5 days out of 7, on a rotating basis that includes weekends and holidays

This schedule is fixed and non-negotiable. If you need a standard 9–5 Monday–Friday schedule, this is not the right fit right now.

Why Join Us?

This is more than a customer support role — it's a chance to be a founding pillar of the guest experience at an exciting startup that's transforming the way people discover rural travel. You'll have real ownership over your work, the freedom to innovate, and the opportunity to grow alongside a passionate, mission-driven team. If you're someone who doesn't just solve problems but actively makes things better, you'll find your people here.

How to Apply:

Our recruitment process is designed to ensure the right fit for you and our team. Here's what to expect:

  • Complete the application form:

  • Screening interview with our recruitment team
  • Interview with the client
  • Final decision – some candidates may have a second client interview before an offer is made

We're looking forward to learning more about you!

Confira esta oportunidade para Web Developer em lauro de freitas. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

Job Title: Web Development Manager

About Client Company:

Our client company is a fast-growing US-based marketing agency focused on building high-performing digital experiences that drive measurable business growth for clients. We cover graphic designs, web designs, web development, and many other services for clients across a wide range of industries.

Role Overview:

We are looking for a Web Development Manager to lead our web team, oversee client web projects, and improve the overall quality and conversion performance of the websites we build.

This is not just a developer role. We are looking for someone who can combine technical expertise, leadership, project management, CRO thinking, and strong client communication skills.

Work Schedule: Flexible 20-30 hours/week to start and transition to full-time very quickly. US Hours.

What You'll Be Responsible For

Leadership & Team Management

  • Lead and mentor the web development team
  • Assign projects based on team strengths and workload capacity
  • Review work to ensure high-quality standards across all projects
  • Support team growth, accountability, and continuous improvement
  • Help improve internal web development processes and workflows

Web Development & CRO

  • Build and optimize websites using Shopify, WordPress, Framer, and Webflow
  • Conduct Conversion Rate Optimization (CRO) audits to improve website performance
  • Identify website issues that negatively impact conversions and user experience
  • Improve site structure, speed, responsiveness, and usability
  • Support troubleshooting and technical problem-solving on complex projects

Project Management

  • Manage multiple web projects simultaneously from kickoff to launch
  • Create timelines, prioritize tasks, and ensure projects are delivered on time
  • Coordinate with designers, marketers, copywriters, and developers
  • Maintain organized project documentation and communication

Client Communication

  • Lead client meetings for website projects
  • Explain technical concepts clearly to non-technical clients
  • Provide project updates and manage client expectations professionally
  • Build strong long-term relationships through excellent customer service

AI & Innovation

  • Use modern AI tools such as Lovable, Google Stitch, and other AI-assisted web development platforms
  • Identify opportunities to improve efficiency using AI workflows
  • Stay updated on emerging AI tools and web development trends
  • Help implement scalable systems and processes using AI technology

Requirements

Technical Experience

  • 3+ years of hands-on web development experience
  • Strong experience with: Shopify, WordPress, Webflow, and Framer.
  • Strong understanding of Conversion Rate Optimization (CRO)
  • Experience identifying conversion bottlenecks and improving website performance
  • Proficiency in HTML, CSS, and JavaScript
  • Understanding of responsive design and mobile optimization
  • Experience with website speed optimization and SEO best practices
  • Familiarity with tracking setup including pixels, Google Tag Manager, and analytics tools

Leadership & Communication

  • Previous experience leading or mentoring developers
  • Strong project management and organizational skills
  • Excellent English communication skills
  • Ability to manage multiple deadlines in a fast-paced agency environment
  • Comfortable working directly with clients and presenting solutions

Bonus Qualifications

  • Experience working in a marketing agency environment
  • Experience with AI-assisted development workflows
  • Familiarity with UX/UI best practices
  • Experience improving operational efficiency within a web team

title: Customer Retention Specialist
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Customer Retention Specialist em camaçari. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

About us:

Smarter Contact is the market-leading AI-powered text and voice communications platform for real estate professionals in the US market. We're building a best-in-class product with world-class talent to serve customers who rave about us. Will you join us?

About you:

This is a direct-hire role. As a Customer Retention Specialist, your primary responsibility is to reduce churn and protect revenue. You will proactively engage canceled and churned accounts via calls, text, and emails to understand why. Most importantly, you'll be the bridge that enables customer success, helping us retain them. As a result, retained revenue will follow with subscription renewals, of which you will be responsible for attaining a monthly quota.

What You'll Own:

  • Responsible for reducing churn by retaining customers and revenue.
  • You'll own a monthly customer retention quota as your main KPI.
  • Apply approved retention strategies (in-app credits, billing credits, plan downgrades, and success enablement) within defined guidelines.
  • Intercept downgrade requests and reposition value through usage planning, campaign scheduling, and ROI alignment before the plan change is approved.
  • Identify and recover failed onboarding cases by re-driving activation and time-to-first-value.
  • Perform proactive outreach to low-usage and disengaged accounts using structured "silent churn" playbooks to re-engage customers before cancellation intent surfaces.
  • Working with the Success team, diagnose root causes of underperformance (targeting, messaging, timing, setup) and implement corrective actions that directly improve campaign outcomes.

What We're Looking For:

  • 5+ years in a customer retention or account management role.
  • 3+ years within a SaaS company.
  • Conduct 50+ weekly retention calls via phone or Google Meet.
  • Proven ability to analyze customer behavior, identify churn risks, and take targeted action to retain accounts.
  • Strong objection handling, negotiation, and behavioral communication skills with the ability to influence customer decisions under pressure.
  • Ability to diagnose and act on different churn drivers (budget, usage, performance, lifecycle, compliance) with tailored retention strategies.
  • Able to work efficiently in a high-activity environment without sacrificing quality.
  • Comfortable holding long-format video calls for reviewing customer accounts and demonstrating product value.
  • Coachable, performance-driven, accountable, and a strong team player.
  • Proficient or native level English (full business fluency).
  • Work a minimum of 40 hours/week between 10 am and 7 pm EST, Monday to Friday.

Bonus Points:

  • Experience working at a CPaaS or Martech SaaS company.
  • Experience working with real estate professionals.

️ Why Smarter Contact?

  • USD base compensation
  • 15 days PTO + 5 sick days + 10 floating holidays (6 weeks off)
  • High autonomy, fast execution, real impact
  • Professional development benefit
  • Wellness benefit
  • Employment anniversary and birthday gift
  • Quarterly health allowance
  • Remote-first team with a strong performance culture
  • This opportunity is offered as a full-time independent contractor role

Please Don't Apply If:

  • You prefer a low-pressure, low-output environment
  • You're not fluent in English or are uncomfortable communicating directly with cross-functional teams
  • You don't meet the minimum customer success experience
  • No experience working for a SaaS company

Ready to grow with us?

We're looking for a proven Customer Retention Specialist ready to build the next chapter of their career — and stay for the long haul. If that's you, we'd love to hear from you.

description:

Gravity Interactive, Inc., established in California in 2003, is a leader in the online gaming industry, providing Gravity games to gamers across North America and beyond.     basic technical aptitude is a plus

title: Sap Basis Engineer
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Sap Basis Engineer em feira de santana. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

Quem Somos

A Dexian, lançada em 2023, tem presença global e traz consigo quase 30 anos de experiência através de suas companhias legadas, principalmente da combinação da DISYS e Signature Consultants.

Iniciamos no Brasil 2007 como DISYS e, de lá para cá, conquistamos mais de 50 clientes de diferentes setores da economia. Como Dexian, passamos a ser uma das maiores empresas de contratação e solução de TI e estamos liderando a indústria por meio de entrega de serviços exclusivos que combina escala global, recursos de serviço completo e agilidade tática para modernizar modelos de contratação, avançar em soluções de mão-de-obra e transformar a infraestrutura tecnológica. Contamos com escritórios estrategicamente localizados em quatro grandes capitais: Curitiba (PR), Porto Alegre (RS), Rio de Janeiro (RJ) e São Paulo (SP). Assim, conseguimos nos manter próximos dos nossos clientes e consultores. Também somos uma Minority Owner Company e nos sentimos orgulhosos de termos nascido na diversidade.

O que esperar de nós

Pessoas estão no centro de nossa estratégia e compõem o nosso maior capital. Temos compromisso de atrair, reter os maiores e melhores talentos e construir conexões reais para a vida. Por isso, atuamos como ponte entre profissionais altamente qualificados e oportunidades consistentes e prósperas. Acreditamos que, trazer o talento, a tecnologia e as organizações certas juntos, ajuda a desbloquear resultados transformadores e alcançar novos níveis de sucessos para os clientes que atendemos e os consultores que contratamos. E para isso, cinco valores fundamentais nos guiam: Integridade, Transparencia, Autenticidade, Engenhosidade e Empatia. Compartilha dos mesmos valores, aqui é seu lugar! Que tal desenvolver sua carreira conosco?

Na Dexian, valorizamos a diversidade.

Acreditamos que diferentes perspectivas, experiências e trajetórias impulsionam a inovação e fortalecem conexões. Por isso, nosso processo de contratação é inclusivo, aberto a candidatos de todas as identidades, habilidades e histórias. Aqui, o que importa é o talento.

Nosso Cliente

Você atuará em um projeto global de grande porte no segmento de energia, com ambiente SAP robusto e crítico, composto por aproximadamente 15 sistemas produtivos ECC e S/4HANA

O que esperar do seu dia a dia de trabalho

  • Administração e configuração de ambientes SAP (Basis)
  • Suporte e sustentação de sistemas SAP (performance, interfaces e disponibilidade)
  • Troubleshooting e resolução de incidentes críticos
  • Monitoramento técnico e tuning de performance
  • Execução de rotinas de manutenção (RFCs, profiles, housekeeping, etc.)
  • Planejamento e execução de upgrades e melhorias
  • Gestão de backup & recovery
  • Atuação com replicação de dados (SLT)
  • Execução de testes de Disaster Recovery e Cyber Recovery
  • Participação em modelo Follow The Sun (FTS) para suporte global
  • Atuação em ambientes ágeis (squads, sprints, backlog - ADO)
  • Participação em escala de plantão (on-call rotativo)

O que você precisa ter

  • Experiência sólida em SAP Basis
  • Vivência com SAP S/4HANA e SAP HANA Database
  • Experiência com SAP NetWeaver (ABAP e Java)
  • Conhecimento em ferramentas como Solution Manager, Focused Run ou SAP LaMa
  • Experiência com troubleshooting, tuning e monitoramento de sistemas SAP
  • Conhecimento em backup & recovery
  • Experiência com replicação de dados (SLT)
  • Conhecimento em sistemas operacionais e suporte a banco de dados
  • Experiência com scripts (PowerShell ou Shell)
  • Vivência com gestão de incidentes, problemas e mudanças
  • Inglês avançado (atuação global)

Será um destaque seu perfil com:

  • Conhecimento em HANA Pacemaker
  • Experiência com ambientes de alta disponibilidade
  • Vivência em projetos globais e ambientes complexos
  • Perfil proativo e colaborativo
  • Facilidade para atuar em times ágeis

Onde você vai trabalhar?

No conforto da sua casa. Regime 100% Home Office

title: Professor De Inglês
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Professor De Inglês em camaçari. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

Junte-se à nossa equipe como professor de inglês remoto!

Na Flyover Idiomas, nosso diferencial está no processo de junção de alunos e professores, que visa aproveitar suas semelhanças, incluindo experiência e personalidade.

Estamos à procura de pessoas dedicadas e entusiasmadas para se juntarem à nossa equipe como professores de inglês remoto. Esta posição oferece a conveniência de trabalhar de qualquer lugar com horários flexíveis.

Sobre nós: Somos uma escola de idiomas online comprometida em oferecer ensino de inglês de alta qualidade para alunos de todas as idades e contextos. Nossa missão é ensinar os alunos através de experiências de aprendizagem personalizadas, utilizando a abordagem comunicativa, com foco na fluência mais do que na precisão, selecionando materiais autênticos e relevantes, e integrando todas as quatro habilidades.

Visão geral da posição

  • Lecionar aulas de inglês, principalmente particulares ou em pequenos grupos.
  • Desenvolver planos de aula e atividades envolventes que atendam a diferentes necessidades de aprendizagem e níveis de proficiência, usando a abordagem comunicativa, focada na autonomia do aluno e na personalização da aula.
  • Participar de treinamentos, reuniões com nossos coordenadores e projetos diversos.
  • Fornecer feedback construtivo e ajudar os alunos a melhorar suas habilidades linguísticas.
  • Enviar relatórios das aulas para manter seus alunos e a escola atualizados sobre o andamento das mesmas.
  • Promover um ambiente de aprendizagem confortável e encorajador com foco no sucesso do alu no.

Formato

  • Contratação: Contrato com Microempreendedor Individual (MEI)
  • Local: Remoto
  • Carga Horária: Você define a sua própria agenda

Requisitos

  • Proficiência em inglês (mínimo C1)
  • Bacharel em Inglês, Educação, Linguística ou áreas similares (certificação TESOL/TEFL é um diferencial).
  • Experiência comprovada no ensino de inglês como segunda língua, seja online ou em sala de aula.
  • Disponibilidade de pelo menos 25 horas/semana, com alguns horários após as 17h (horário de São Paulo).
  • Habilidades de comunicação e de relacionamento interpessoal.
  • Conexão de internet estável, computador, webcam, espaço de trabalho privado e silencioso.
  • Familiaridade com plataformas de ensino online.
  • CNPJ / MEI ativo.

Por que se juntar à nós?

  • Flexibilidade: Trabalhe de qualquer lugar com um horário flexível que se adapte ao seu estilo de vida.
  • Impacto: Fazer a diferença na vida dos alunos, ajudando-os a atingir seus objetivos de aprendizagem.
  • Crescimento Profissional: Acesso a oportunidades de desenvolvimento profissional e treinamento contínuo para aprimorar suas habilidades de ensino.
  • Comunidade de Apoio: Junte-se a uma equipe de educadores que se dedicam ao sucesso dos alunos e à melhoria contínua.

title: Executive Assistant To Chief Executive Officer
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Executive Assistant To Chief Executive Officer em lauro de freitas. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

Beige is looking for an exceptional Executive Assistant to work directly with our Founder & CEO across operations, investor relations, communications, partnerships, personal brand, and high-level business execution.

This is not a traditional assistant position. You will operate as an extension of the CEO and help manage the fast-moving day-to-day environment of a rapidly growing media technology startup.

If you're someone who thrives in high-performance environments, loves organization, thinks three steps ahead, and enjoys solving problems before they happen, we want to hear from you.

About Beige

Beige is an AI-powered media technology platform transforming how content is booked, produced, managed, and delivered at scale.

Through Beige.App, businesses, brands, creators, events, families, and enterprises can seamlessly access content production, media services, creative talent, and technology-driven workflows through a modern, intelligent platform.

We have facilitated thousands of productions and work with startups, major brands, Fortune 500 companies, athletes, creators, celebrities, and high-profile individuals across the United States and internationally. We're building much more than a service company — we're building infrastructure for the future of content.

As Beige scales aggressively, we're building a team obsessed with speed, ownership, execution, innovation, and growth.

Location & Schedule
  • Location: Remote (International / Global Talent)
  • Schedule: Monday – Friday, 9:00 AM – 6:00 PM PST
  • Note: Operational flexibility outside standard hours when necessary is a strong plus, as startup environments move quickly.
Compensation
  • Contract Rate: Starting at $1,000/month plus performance-based milestones and bonuses. Significant long-term growth opportunities are available for exceptional track-record execution.
What You'll Be Doing
  • Managing the CEO's calendar, meetings, travel, scheduling, reminders, and priorities.
  • Acting as a gatekeeper and organizer for daily communication and inbound opportunities.
  • Following up on leads, partnerships, investors, advisors, clients, and strategic relationships.
  • Supporting investor relations efforts, fundraising outreach, and executive communications.
  • Helping manage aspects of the CEO's personal brand, public presence, and social media activity.
  • Drafting emails, presentations, summaries, reports, meeting notes, and business communications.
  • Helping organize and execute projects across multiple departments while tracking deadlines.
  • Coordinating with team members, vendors, partners, and external stakeholders.
  • Turning conversations into action items and ensuring execution actually happens.
  • Assisting with research projects and identifying business opportunities.
  • Acting as an extension of the CEO during meetings and ensuring nothing falls through the cracks.
Who We're Looking ForRequired Qualifications:
  • Elite English Proficiency: 10/10 fluent written and spoken English with exceptional professional communication skills.
  • Previous experience directly supporting a Founder, CEO, Executive, or startup leadership team.
  • Strong organizational, project management, and execution skills.
  • Proven ability to work independently with minimal supervision and high autonomy.
  • Extremely proactive mindset—you naturally identify and solve problems before they escalate.
  • Strong executive presence, professional judgment, and absolute discretion.
  • High emotional intelligence;
    comfortable communicating with high-profile individuals and personalities.
  • High adaptability and a calm demeanor when priorities shift quickly in a fast-paced environment.
Preferred / Major Plus:
  • Deep experience within media, content production, technology, entertainment, creator economy, or startup ecosystems.
  • Prior exposure to investor relations, fundraising workflows, or capital raises.
  • Basic graphic design experience (Canva, Adobe, Figma) for creating presentations and marketing assets.
  • Social media management or personal brand building experience.
  • CRM fluency (HubSpot, GoHighLevel, Salesforce, etc.).
  • Advanced proficiency using AI tools (ChatGPT, automation platforms) and modern productivity suites (Google Workspace, Slack, Asana, Notion).
Core Behavioral Expectations:

To succeed in this role, you must thrive on high-speed execution, welcome rapidly shifting priorities, and actively prefer dynamic problem-solving over highly repetitive, predictable administrative tasks.

How to Apply

We are moving fast to fill this position. If you are ready to operate at an elite executive level, please submit:

  • Your Resume
  • A short introduction video (2–3 minutes) detailing:
  • Your specific experience supporting founders, CEOs, or fast-growing startups.
  • Why you are a perfect fit for the culture at Beige.
  • Your favorite productivity and AI tools that you currently use to optimize your workflow.

title: Talent Acquisition Partner
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Talent Acquisition Partner em lauro de freitas. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

Talent Acquisition Partner (Active Sourcing)

Location: Fully Remote (Must be based in LATAM)

Job Type: Full-Time

About Uproot Clean

Uproot Clean is a fast-growing consumer products company with more than 5 million customers using our products. Our products are sold not only through DTC and Amazon, but also through major retailers, including Walmart, Target, and Petco, along with more than 10,000 retail doors across the country. Uproot has also been featured across major television and media platforms, including QVC, Good Morning America, and Fox, helping introduce millions of consumers to the brand.

We care deeply about building products that genuinely solve problems for pet owners while operating with high standards across every part of the business. We are building a company focused on long-term excellence, creating significant opportunities for highly capable people who want real and meaningful impact, and the ability to help shape the future of the company.

About the Role

This is a hands-on execution role focused 100% on active sourcing. You will proactively identify and engage high-quality talent across multiple functions and seniority levels using multiple sourcing channels, advanced search techniques, and thoughtful outreach.

Success requires high-output execution, strong judgment, persistence, excellent communication, and the ability to operate with urgency in a fast-moving environment.

Responsibilities

Active Sourcing

  • Proactively source candidates across multiple job boards, platforms, and sourcing channels
  • Use advanced Boolean search techniques to identify strong talent
  • Build pipelines across multiple functions and seniority levels
  • Identify strong passive candidates
  • Partner closely with recruiting and hiring managers to align on hiring needs.

Candidate Outreach

  • Write outbound messaging that drives candidate engagement
  • Qualify candidates early in the process
  • Move qualified candidates into the recruiting workflow

Pipeline Management

  • Maintain organized sourcing workflows and candidate tracking
  • Continuously improve sourcing strategies and outreach quality
  • Continuously iterate on sourcing methods, messaging, and targeting

What Success Looks Like

  • Consistently builds high-quality candidate pipelines
  • Surfaces strong candidates quickly across multiple functions
  • Generates strong response and assessment completion rates
  • Operates with speed, consistency, and minimal oversight
  • Raises the overall talent bar of the company over time

Requirements

Must Have

  • 1+ year of full-time active sourcing experience - mandatory
  • Experience sourcing across multiple job boards and sourcing platforms
  • Strong outbound recruiting and candidate outreach skills
  • Experience using advanced Boolean search techniques
  • Excellent written English communication skills
  • Ability to manage multiple open searches simultaneously

Strong Plus

  • Experience sourcing across multiple functions and seniority levels
  • Experience in high-growth, e-commerce, or performance-driven companies
  • Familiarity with LinkedIn Recruiter and modern sourcing tools

Work Requirements

Schedule: Monday-Friday, 8:00 AM - 5:00 PM EST

Workspace: Fixed, professional setup (no digital nomads)

Output: Daily briefs and feedback loops (high consistency required)

Who This Role Is For (& Not For)

This Role Is For You If:

  • You enjoy the challenge of finding exceptional people before anyone else does
  • You are naturally proactive and internally driven
  • You move quickly, stay organized, and maintain high standards
  • You enjoy performance-oriented environments with accountability
  • You think recruiting is a high-leverage business function, not administrative work
  • You enjoy improving systems, processes, and sourcing quality over time

This Role Is NOT For You If:

  • You need constant direction or external motivation
  • You struggle with consistency and follow-through
  • You are uncomfortable persuading passive candidates
  • You treat recruiting as scheduling and coordination only

Compensation & Benefits

Uproot Clean is a high ownership, high accountability environment with high standards for communication, speed, execution, and quality. We care far more about ability, judgment, and ownership than credentials or years of experience.

  • Salary: Competitive base salary + performance-based bonus structure
  • Significant autonomy with the ability to directly influence the company's growth and direction
  • Fully remote: work from anywhere
  • PTO: 2 Weeks
  • Flex Day: An additional quarterly day off dedicated to rest and recovery
  • Thinking Day: one dedicated day each quarter to step away from day-to-day execution and think deeply about your role, systems, ideas, and long-term impact
  • Wellness Reimbursement: $100-$300/month, based on location, to help support your wellness.
  • Pet Reimbursement: $40-100/month, based on location to help support parenting a pet.
  • Coaching credits: $1,000+/year for coaching, education, and professional development

Ready to Apply?

If you are excited by high standards, proactive recruiting, and the challenge of building world-class talent pipelines, we'd love to hear from you.

About Turing:

Based in San Francisco, California, Turing is the world's leading research accelerator for frontier AI labs and a trusted partner for global enterprises deploying advanced AI systems. Turing supports customers in two ways: first, by accelerating frontier research with high-quality data, advanced training pipelines, plus top AI researchers who specialize in coding, reasoning, STEM, multilinguality, multimodality, and agents;

We are seeking a highly analytical and computationally proficient individual to join our team with a strong research background. You will be instrumental in contributing to this role by either crafting challenging and insightful problems in your respective research domain, devising elegant computational solutions.

Responsibilities:

  • Build multi-agent benchmark tasks that require reading, analyzing, and synthesizing large document collections
  • Curate real-world research corpora — academic papers, case studies, technical reports — and design questions that require comprehensive analysis
  • Write structured ground-truth oracles (JSON) with specific, verifiable answers that prove the agent actually read the source material
  • Design LLM judge prompts that evaluate agent output field-by-field against the oracle
  • Create decomposition guides that split research across multiple parallel sub-agents (one per document, one per domain, then synthesis)

Required Qualifications:

  • 5+ years of research experience (academic or industry) in any scientific domain
  • Strong reading comprehension with ability to extract structured data from unstructured text
  • Experience with JSON and data structures, including schema design and output validation
  • Proficiency in Python scripting for data processing and evaluation (e.G., judge scripts)
  • Familiarity with AI coding benchmarks such as SWE-bench and Terminal-bench
  • Hands-on experience with Docker (writing Dockerfiles, building images, debugging containers)
  • High attention to detail, especially for creating precise evaluation oracles without approximations

Nice to have:

  • Experience with systematic reviews, meta-analyses, or large-scale literature surveys
  • Familiarity with medical, legal, or scientific document analysis
  • Experience with NLP or information extraction tasks
  • Knowledge of LLM evaluation and benchmarking (e.G., MMLU, GPQA, SimpleQA)
  • Experience curating datasets for AI evaluation

Perks of Freelancing With Turing:

  • Work in a fully remote environment.
  • Opportunity to work on cutting-edge AI projects with leading LLM companies.
  • Potential for contract extension based on performance and project needs.

Offer Details:

  • Commitments required: 40 hours /week with 4 hours of PST Overlap
  • Engagement type: Contractor assignment/freelancer (no medical/paid leave)
  • Duration of contract: 1 month;
    (expected start date isnext week)

title: Regional Study Director, Latam
description:

Crinetics is a pharmaceutical company headquartered in San Diego, California, with a growing presence in Latin America, including an office in Brazil. We are developing much-needed therapies for people with endocrine diseases and endocrine-related tumors. We were founded by a dedicated team of scientists with the simple belief that better therapies developed from rigorous innovation can lead to better lives. Our work continues to make a real difference in the lives of patients. We have a prolific discovery engine and a robust preclinical and clinical development pipeline. We are driven by science with a patient-centric and team-oriented culture. Crinetics is known for its inclusive workplace culture. This is an exciting time to join Crinetics as we expand our operations in Latin America and shape our organization into the world's premier fully integrated endocrine company from discovery to patients. Join our team as we transform the lives of others.

Position Summary:

Please note, the candidate for this role will need to be located in Brazil.

The Regional Study Director, LATAM is responsible for managing the execution of clinical studies and data collection within the LATAM region. The incumbent will serve as a regional clinical study lead who oversees the review, monitoring, and adherence to clinical protocols, as well as managing and building relationships with clinical sites in LATAM. The Regional Study Director, LATAM may oversee other regional study leads within the region to facilitate a streamlined and quality study execution. This role will also work internally and externally with members of the cross-functional study team.

Essential Job Functions and Responsibilities:

These may include but are not limited to:

  • Provide oversight of clinical research studies for LATAM.
  • Manage and build relationships with clinical research sites in LATAM.
  • May oversee the work of other regional study leads within LATAM.
  • Provide operational and strategic input into study documents such as synopsis, protocol, ICF, CRFs, CRF Completion Guidelines, Study Execution Plans, Clinical Data Review Plan, Clinical Database edit specifications, Clinical Study Report (CSR) development, etc.
  • Oversight of all regional vendors and activities including CROs.
  • Oversee regional start up activities including site selection, enrollment projections and activities driving site activation.
  • Develop region specific the subject recruitment/retention strategy and related initiatives.
  • Oversight of regional TMF ongoing quality review, and final reconciliation of study documents including review of site regulatory documents/packages and obtaining of appropriate site insurance, and/or supervision of team members performing these activities.
  • Development of training materials for study team, investigational sites, and vendors.
  • Proactive management of information sharing with key stakeholders using standardized reports and other mechanisms.
  • Assure clinical studies are compliant with GDPR, ICH/GCP and other regulations as appropriate.
  • Outline regional activation hurdles for team.
  • Participate in RFP development and prepare bid templates to facilitate selection of the CROs/vendors, and/or collaboration/supervision with team members performing these activities.
  • Collaborate with counsel to negotiate and draft research contracts and agreements with CROs/vendors and clinical study sites, as needed.
  • Acts as liaison with Regulatory Affairs to assure adherence to GDPR, GCPs;
    maintenance of SOPs;
    and assure site and CRO/vendor audits are completed.
  • Perform regional risk management and implement mitigations.
  • Identify potential study issues and recommend and implement solutions or corrective actions as needed.
  • Create realistic plans that clearly define goals, milestones, responsibilities, and results.
  • Maintain focus on strategic objectives while accomplishing operational goals.
  • Make timely, data-driven decisions.
  • Manage daily activities, assign tasks, goals, and development of direct reports.
  • Other duties as assigned.

Required Education and Experience:

  • Bachelor's degree required, preferably in scientific discipline. An equivalent combination of relevant education and applicable job experience may be considered.
  • 12 years of prior clinical operations experience preferably with CRO/small biotech experience and approximately 8 years of experience in a supervisory role.
  • Must be able to travel 25-50% of time, may be higher in accordance with project requirements.
  • Computer skills should include proficiency with Microsoft Office suite of software, electronic TMF systems, IXRS and EDC systems.
  • Excellent understanding of drug development process.
  • Experience in clinical trial supply management.
  • Able to make appropriate decisions to move the project(s) forward.
  • Effective verbal and written communication skills.
  • Data flow from sites to data processing, review, and resolution.
  • Analysis and report generation.
  • Knowledge of local regulatory requirements.
  • Ability to handle multiple tasks to meet deadlines in a dynamic environment is essential.
  • Study initiation procedures.
  • Ability to exercise judgment and determine appropriate action

Travel:

You may be required to travel for up to 25-50% of your time.

title: Senior Solutions Architect (Composable Commerce)
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Senior Solutions Architect (Composable Commerce) em salvador. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

Avenue Code is the leading software consultancy focused on delivering end-to-end development solutions for digital transformation across every vertical. We prefer the word ‘partner’ over ‘vendor’, and our investment in professional relationships is a reflection of that philosophy. We pride ourselves on our technical acumen, our collaborative problem-solving ability, and the warm professionalism of our teams. About the Opportunity: As a Solutions Architect specialized in Data & AI, you will be responsible for driving business growth, expanding our market share, and accelerating our strategic partnership with Google Cloud. This is a highly strategic, technical-commercial role. You will act as the trusted advisor for our clients, identifying new business opportunities, understanding complex business challenges, and architecting customized Google Cloud Data & AI solutions. Your ultimate goal is to bridge the gap between technical excellence and business value, presenting high-impact pitches to C-level executives to close deals and maximize Google Cloud adoption. Key Responsibilities: Business Development & Pipeline Growth: Identify, qualify, and develop new business opportunities for Data and Generative AI solutions within our Google Cloud ecosystem. Google Partnership Alignment: Work closely with Google Cloud’s internal sales and technical teams (Partner Managers, Account Executives, and CE/CEs) to co-sell, align strategies, and map target accounts. Executive Pitching & Value Selling: Lead discovery sessions and deliver compelling technical-commercial pitches to C-Level executives (CDO, CIO, CTO, CMO), translating complex technical architectures into clear business outcomes, ROI, and strategic value. Solution Architecture & Prototyping: Design high-level, customized data architectures and coordinate rapid Proof of Concepts (PoCs) on Google Cloud to validate value and accelerate the client’s buying decision. Proposal & RFP Leadership: Own the technical-commercial strategy for complex proposals and RFPs, defining the scope, commercial engineering, and value proposition of the proposed Google Cloud solution. Advanced English Required Qualifications: Proven BDM or Technical Pre-Sales Experience: Solid track record in Business Development, Technical Sales, or Solution Architecture within the IT/Cloud Consulting industry, specifically driving cloud revenue. Google Cloud Ecosystem Expertise: Deep knowledge of Google Cloud's data portfolio (BigQuery, Cloud Composer, Dataproc, Pub/Sub, Dataflow). AI & Generative AI Acumen: Solid understanding of Google Cloud’s AI capabilities (Vertex AI, Model Garden, Gemini API), and how to position them to solve real-world business problems. C-Level Communication & Storytelling: Outstanding communication, presentation, and negotiation skills, with the ability to build trust and influence decision-makers at the executive level. Commercial Strategy: Ability to structure complex deals, build business cases focused on ROI, and understand consumption-based cloud business models. Data Strategy Knowledge: Strong understanding of modern data paradigms, such as Data Lakes, Data Governance, Data Mesh, and how data readiness impacts AI success. Preferred Qualifications: Google Cloud Certifications: Google Cloud Professional Data Engineer, Cloud Architect, or Digital Leader certifications are a strong differentiator. Partner Ecosystem Experience: Prior experience working within the Google Cloud partner ecosystem or directly at Google. Technical Background: Previous hands-on experience as a Data Engineer, Data Architect, or Data Scientist is a plus, ensuring high technical credibility with clients' engineering teams. Work Environment: A fast-paced, high-growth environment focused on innovation and results. High visibility, working directly with strategic clients and global tech leaders (Google). Direct impact on the company’s revenue growth and strategic partnership status. A Avenue Code reforça seu compromisso com a privacidade e com todos os princípios assegurados pelas legislações de proteção de dados mais rigorosas do mundo, como a GDPR, LGPD, CCPA e CPRA. Os dados dos(as) candidatos(as) compartilhados com a Avenue Code serão mantidos sob confidencialidade e não serão transmitidos a terceiros não envolvidos, nem utilizados para finalidades distintas do processo de candidatura às posições em aberto. title: Especialista De Machine Learning I
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Especialista De Machine Learning I em camaçari. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

Fullinfo is looking for a Senior Machine Learning Engineer who enjoys turning messy web data into structured, reliable company intelligence. This is not a research role, management track or career step for people who mainly want to move up. It is a hands on engineering role for someone who gets satisfaction from solving complex data problems properly. About us Fullinfo is a self funded software company building a B2B company intelligence platform. We continuously crawl the open web and turn unstructured company websites, directories, registries and industry sources into clean, searchable company profiles. The result is a global database where users can search for specific company data and actually get the right answer. The product helps sales and marketing teams search across company data in a way that feels simple on the surface, but is technically complex underneath. Think natural language search, structured filters, company enrichment, relationship detection and reliable classification across many countries, industries and languages. Fullinfo currently works with a compact team of around 11 people, including backend engineers, frontend engineers, UX UI designers, DevOps and machine learning specialists. The team is small, international and focused on people who actually build, improve and ship the product. The culture is calm, direct and quality driven. People say what they do and do what they say. There is little room for ego, politics or vague ambition talk. The best fit is someone who is quietly driven, technically strong and genuinely interested in building something that works well. This is not the environment for people who constantly reinvent their profile, chase the next title or need a lot of structure around them. It is a strong fit for stable engineers who know their craft and like working with other people who take quality seriously. Role description As Senior Machine Learning Engineer, you will work on the intelligence layer at the heart of Fullinfo’s product. Your work turns raw, noisy and unstructured web content into trustworthy data points. This includes things like industry classification, company maturity stage, tech stack, geography served, corporate hierarchy, entity matching and relationship detection. You will write Python, build and improve ML pipelines, integrate LLMs, evaluate model quality and make sure the system keeps producing accurate results at scale. The stack includes Python, Pandas, scikit learn, Transformers, boto3, AWS Lambda, SageMaker, S3, ECS, Terraform, Go and TypeScript. You will work closely with a small engineering team, but this is not a role where someone tells you every step to take. The direction is clear, the expectations are high, and the work needs to be done properly. You need to be comfortable figuring things out, validating assumptions and improving quality without needing constant confirmation. Your work includes: - Designing and improving models for classification, entity resolution and relationship detection - Working with noisy web scraped data across many languages and formats - Building ML pipelines that run reliably in production - Using LLMs for extraction, enrichment, validation and search related use cases - Working with embeddings, RAG, fine tuning and prompt engineering where it actually adds value - Defining evaluation metrics so model quality is measurable instead of based on gut feeling - Monitoring deployed models and improving them over time - Working with AWS services such as Lambda, SageMaker, S3 and ECS - Collaborating with backend engineers on production systems and data flows This role is a strong fit for someone who enjoys deep technical problems more than status. Someone who would rather fix a broken classification result than talk about building a team under them. Requirements You bring: - At least 5 years of hands on ML engineering experience - Strong Python skills - Experience with libraries such as Pandas, scikit learn, Transformers and boto3 - Real production experience with ML on AWS - Experience with LLMs, embeddings, RAG, prompt engineering or fine tuning - Comfort working with large scale, messy and semi structured data - Experience with JSON, NoSQL data and scraped web content - A strong eye for correctness and data quality - Business level English - The ability to work independently in a small remote team - A stable track record that shows depth, consistency and ownership Conditions - 12 month B2B contract - Fully remote work (GMT -3), you are allowed to have a 3 hour overlap - Flat structure with direct communication - Production product with real users and real data problems - Strong technical challenge around ML, LLMs, search and company intelligence - Compensation based on senior contractor level The hiring process includes an intro call, a technical assignment and a final conversation with the engineering team. Interested? Apply trough the link and get in touch with our consultant Lars Fullinfo is exclusively partnering with Haystack People for this role. They will support you throughout the process and handle the initial screening, focusing on both your relevant experience and the soft skills that match Fullinfo’s needs.

title: Especialista De Machine Learning I
