Fullinfo is looking for a Senior Machine Learning Engineer who enjoys turning messy web data into structured, reliable company intelligence. This is not a research role, management track or career step for people who mainly want to move up. It is a hands on engineering role for someone who gets satisfaction from solving complex data problems properly. About us Fullinfo is a self funded software company building a B2B company intelligence platform. We continuously crawl the open web and turn unstructured company websites, directories, registries and industry sources into clean, searchable company profiles. The result is a global database where users can search for specific company data and actually get the right answer. The product helps sales and marketing teams search across company data in a way that feels simple on the surface, but is technically complex underneath. Think natural language search, structured filters, company enrichment, relationship detection and reliable classification across many countries, industries and languages. Fullinfo currently works with a compact team of around 11 people, including backend engineers, frontend engineers, UX UI designers, DevOps and machine learning specialists. The team is small, international and focused on people who actually build, improve and ship the product. The culture is calm, direct and quality driven. People say what they do and do what they say. There is little room for ego, politics or vague ambition talk. The best fit is someone who is quietly driven, technically strong and genuinely interested in building something that works well. This is not the environment for people who constantly reinvent their profile, chase the next title or need a lot of structure around them. It is a strong fit for stable engineers who know their craft and like working with other people who take quality seriously. Role description As Senior Machine Learning Engineer, you will work on the intelligence layer at the heart of Fullinfo’s product. Your work turns raw, noisy and unstructured web content into trustworthy data points. This includes things like industry classification, company maturity stage, tech stack, geography served, corporate hierarchy, entity matching and relationship detection. You will write Python, build and improve ML pipelines, integrate LLMs, evaluate model quality and make sure the system keeps producing accurate results at scale. The stack includes Python, Pandas, scikit learn, Transformers, boto3, AWS Lambda, SageMaker, S3, ECS, Terraform, Go and TypeScript. You will work closely with a small engineering team, but this is not a role where someone tells you every step to take. The direction is clear, the expectations are high, and the work needs to be done properly. You need to be comfortable figuring things out, validating assumptions and improving quality without needing constant confirmation. Your work includes: - Designing and improving models for classification, entity resolution and relationship detection - Working with noisy web scraped data across many languages and formats - Building ML pipelines that run reliably in production - Using LLMs for extraction, enrichment, validation and search related use cases - Working with embeddings, RAG, fine tuning and prompt engineering where it actually adds value - Defining evaluation metrics so model quality is measurable instead of based on gut feeling - Monitoring deployed models and improving them over time - Working with AWS services such as Lambda, SageMaker, S3 and ECS - Collaborating with backend engineers on production systems and data flows This role is a strong fit for someone who enjoys deep technical problems more than status. Someone who would rather fix a broken classification result than talk about building a team under them. Requirements You bring: - At least 5 years of hands on ML engineering experience - Strong Python skills - Experience with libraries such as Pandas, scikit learn, Transformers and boto3 - Real production experience with ML on AWS - Experience with LLMs, embeddings, RAG, prompt engineering or fine tuning - Comfort working with large scale, messy and semi structured data - Experience with JSON, NoSQL data and scraped web content - A strong eye for correctness and data quality - Business level English - The ability to work independently in a small remote team - A stable track record that shows depth, consistency and ownership Conditions - 12 month B2B contract - Fully remote work (GMT -3), you are allowed to have a 3 hour overlap - Flat structure with direct communication - Production product with real users and real data problems - Strong technical challenge around ML, LLMs, search and company intelligence - Compensation based on senior contractor level The hiring process includes an intro call, a technical assignment and a final conversation with the engineering team. Interested? Apply trough the link and get in touch with our consultant Lars Fullinfo is exclusively partnering with Haystack People for this role. They will support you throughout the process and handle the initial screening, focusing on both your relevant experience and the soft skills that match Fullinfo’s needs.

title: Landholder And Reforestation Delivery Manager
description:

About NatureCo NatureCo delivers nature-based solutions (NbS) for investors, corporates and other purpose driven organisations to scale up action on climate change and biodiversity loss. We specialise in nature-based project development including reforestation, agroforestry, farmer managed natural regeneration and mangrove restoration. NatureCo has extensive expertise in working with local communities to protect and restore natural ecosystems through participation in the global voluntary carbon market. NatureCo is currently implementing a large-scale reforestation project in Brazil for the generation of verified carbon credits. We are a diverse, mission-driven team that values inclusion, integrity, and innovation. NatureCo is proud to be an Equal Opportunity Employer, committed to building an equitable and inclusive workplace for all. Role and responsibilities The Landholder and Reforestation Delivery Manager is the primary field-based interface with landholders, communities, reforestation contractors, and other local stakeholders for NatureCo’s projects in Brazil. This position will build and manage a pipeline of landholders interested in reforestation, lead outreach and onboarding, coordinate site inspections, lead the collection of relevant data required for carbon standard checks, and lead signature of landholder agreements. The role will also play a key role in ensuring compliance (contracts and carbon standards) as well as coordinate schedules between landholders and contractors for the implementation of reforestation activities. This will include confirming site readiness, conducting periodic field quality audits, documenting and tracking progress, and resolving issues that could delay delivery or degrade quality. The role requires a strong combination stakeholder engagement and management experience, and a commitment to quality and impact. The role requires extensive travel and field work across Minas Gerais, Bahia and Espírito Santo. Primary roles and responsibilities include: Landholder engagement, onboarding, and pipeline management Map priority municipalities and referral partner networks (city governments, co-ops, farmer associations, NGOs);
plan and run outreach activities, events and information sessions. Manage the landholder onboarding process (identify → qualify → onboard → contract), using CRM/trackers to keep status, documents and next actions current. Prepare clear information packs (benefits, obligations, timelines) and respond to inquiries in a timely, professional manner. Maintain ongoing landholder relationship management to support retention, satisfaction, and smooth site access throughout implementation. Eligibility, due diligence & agreements Coordinate site inspections and initial diagnostics in consultation with other team members (parcel boundaries, vegetation status, access, water, risks). Support land tenure verification and FPIC documentation Lead closure of contract signatures. Maintain organized repository of all landholder records within NatureCo’s data management system (land titles, eligibility documents, contracts, site maps, inspection notes, photos, consultation records). Reforestation delivery enablement Translate signed landholder agreements into implementation-ready site plans (site-specific scope, access instructions, constraints, schedule windows). Align field schedules with landholders and contractors to ensure access, minimize disruption to farm activities, and maintain trust and cooperation. Support in the delivery of field delivery progress from contractors by site (start/finish dates, activities completed, challenges, next steps), and escalate issues early (access, weather delays, input shortages, labor constraints). Support in monitoring reforestation activities (during and post planting) and coordinate, where required, rapid response with contractors/landholders (grazing, fire risk, pests, drought stress). Stakeholder engagement and safeguards Plan and document stakeholder consultations and community meetings in accordance with NatureCo policies and procedures (agendas, attendance lists, minutes, photos). Support the team in the operation of the grievance mechanism: receiving grievances and responding in accordance with the NatureCo grievance mechanism. Maintain landholder contact and ensure landholder information is kept up to date. Coordinate access, for other project staff and contractors as required. Reporting Lead or assist the development of formal monthly, quarterly, and annual project implementation reports for internal and external stakeholders in line with contract and/or carbon standard requirements. Prepare ad hoc reports, documents, and presentations for internal and external stakeholders. Teamwork and culture Support the management of a cross-functional, international team, fostering collaboration and ensuring that project milestones and goals are met. Stay current on emerging best practices in NbS and carbon projects;
proactively share insights across the organisation and with partners. Skills and attributes To perform successfully in this role, you will have: A minimum of five (5) years of experience in reforestation projects with direct contact with rural landholders and reforestation planting service providers. Degree in forest engineering, agronomy, ecology, or environmental science. Intermediate English and native Portuguese language skills Excellent written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to engage confidently across cultures and stakeholder groups. Strong project management skills, including experience managing timelines, deliverables, and working across multidisciplinary teams. A proactive, self-starting approach with the ability to anticipate problems, adapt quickly, and take initiative under limited supervision. A collaborative mindset and ability to lead and motivate internal teams and external partners Ability to provide strategic and technical guidance across complex, multi-stakeholder projects. Strong organisational skills and attention to detail in documentation and reporting. A positive, energetic personality with resilience and drive to see projects through to delivery. Extensive travel within Brazil is a requirement to perform this position. Location Remote, with residence in Minas Gerais, Espirito Santo, or Bahia Submission instructions Email CV and brief cover letter to with subject: Landholder and Reforestation Delivery Manager Submission deadline: 30 March 2026

title: Especialista De Machine Learning I
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Especialista De Machine Learning I em feira de santana. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

Fullinfo is looking for a Senior Machine Learning Engineer who enjoys turning messy web data into structured, reliable company intelligence. This is not a research role, management track or career step for people who mainly want to move up. It is a hands on engineering role for someone who gets satisfaction from solving complex data problems properly. About us Fullinfo is a self funded software company building a B2B company intelligence platform. We continuously crawl the open web and turn unstructured company websites, directories, registries and industry sources into clean, searchable company profiles. The result is a global database where users can search for specific company data and actually get the right answer. The product helps sales and marketing teams search across company data in a way that feels simple on the surface, but is technically complex underneath. Think natural language search, structured filters, company enrichment, relationship detection and reliable classification across many countries, industries and languages. Fullinfo currently works with a compact team of around 11 people, including backend engineers, frontend engineers, UX UI designers, DevOps and machine learning specialists. The team is small, international and focused on people who actually build, improve and ship the product. The culture is calm, direct and quality driven. People say what they do and do what they say. There is little room for ego, politics or vague ambition talk. The best fit is someone who is quietly driven, technically strong and genuinely interested in building something that works well. This is not the environment for people who constantly reinvent their profile, chase the next title or need a lot of structure around them. It is a strong fit for stable engineers who know their craft and like working with other people who take quality seriously. Role description As Senior Machine Learning Engineer, you will work on the intelligence layer at the heart of Fullinfo’s product. Your work turns raw, noisy and unstructured web content into trustworthy data points. This includes things like industry classification, company maturity stage, tech stack, geography served, corporate hierarchy, entity matching and relationship detection. You will write Python, build and improve ML pipelines, integrate LLMs, evaluate model quality and make sure the system keeps producing accurate results at scale. The stack includes Python, Pandas, scikit learn, Transformers, boto3, AWS Lambda, SageMaker, S3, ECS, Terraform, Go and TypeScript. You will work closely with a small engineering team, but this is not a role where someone tells you every step to take. The direction is clear, the expectations are high, and the work needs to be done properly. You need to be comfortable figuring things out, validating assumptions and improving quality without needing constant confirmation. Your work includes: - Designing and improving models for classification, entity resolution and relationship detection - Working with noisy web scraped data across many languages and formats - Building ML pipelines that run reliably in production - Using LLMs for extraction, enrichment, validation and search related use cases - Working with embeddings, RAG, fine tuning and prompt engineering where it actually adds value - Defining evaluation metrics so model quality is measurable instead of based on gut feeling - Monitoring deployed models and improving them over time - Working with AWS services such as Lambda, SageMaker, S3 and ECS - Collaborating with backend engineers on production systems and data flows This role is a strong fit for someone who enjoys deep technical problems more than status. custom API integrations with payer and health plan systems Debugging data quality issues — conflicting sources of truth, deduplication, schema mismatches, and edge cases specific to healthcare data we’re looking for Strong backend engineering fundamentals — APIs, data pipelines, distributed systems Experience integrating with enterprise systems, ideally in healthcare (payer, EHR, claims) but complex enterprise integrations in other industries count too Comfort working directly with customers and translating ambiguous requirements into clean technical solutions Experience with data quality challenges — deduplication, schema mapping, reconciliation across multiple sources of truth Strong written and spoken communication in English — you’ll be collaborating with teams and customers across time zones Ability to work autonomously from detailed technical specs while flagging blockers and ambiguity early Timezone compatibility with US East Coast ET) working hours What’s in it for you This is an opportunity to join a company at its major inflection point, using cutting- edge technology to have a meaningful impact in healthcare. You’ll work with a world-class team, hold significant responsibility, and have the opportunity to learn and grow rapidly. We offer We welcome new ideas and allow you to make an immediate impact on the team. Flexible Paid time off (PTO for any reason, including sick days (no specified limits) and flexible work schedule). title: Emerging Market Trader
description:

Role Overview We are seeking a highly skilled Emerging Markets FX Trader with deep expertise in African and/or Latin American currencies to join our global trading & liquidity team. The ideal candidate will have extensive experience managing illiquid and restricted FX markets, executing OTC and interbank trades, and designing robust hedging and liquidity frameworks to support high-volume cross-border payment flows. This role requires both strong trading capability and infrastructure expertise, including building and optimizing FX trading systems, hedging engines, and liquidity connectivity with banks, brokers, and OTC counterparties. Key Responsibilities FX Trading & Liquidity Management Manage proprietary and flow-driven FX trading positions across Emerging Market currencies, with a focus on African (e.G., NGN, KES, ZAR, GHS) or LATAM (e.G., BRL, MXN, COP, ARS) markets. Source and maintain deep liquidity relationships with banks, brokers, and OTC desks across relevant regions. Execute spot, forwards, NDFs, swaps, and OTC trades to optimize execution quality and manage currency exposure. Monitor market developments, capital controls, and liquidity dynamics across EM FX markets. Hedging Strategy & Risk Management Design and implement FX hedging strategies to manage corporate or client-driven exposures. Optimize hedging efficiency across multiple liquidity venues including banks, ECNs, OTC desks, and crypto liquidity pools where relevant. Develop models for dynamic hedging, inventory risk management, and spread optimization. Monitor risk limits, PnL, and exposure across currency books. Trading Infrastructure & Systems Work closely with engineering and product teams to build and enhance FX trading and hedging infrastructure, including: Automated hedging engines Liquidity aggregation systems Smart order routing Pricing and risk management tools Integrate connectivity with banks, ECNs, and liquidity providers via APIs or FIX protocols. Improve execution automation, latency optimization, and real-time exposure monitoring. Market Development Identify and onboard new liquidity providers and OTC trading partners across emerging markets. Build pricing frameworks for illiquid currency pairs and support new corridor launches. Contribute to the development of scalable FX infrastructure supporting global payments and settlement flows. Requirements Experience 5–10+ years of FX trading experience in Emerging Markets. Strong experience trading African or LATAM currencies, such as: Africa: NGN, KES, ZAR, GHS, EGP LATAM: BRL, MXN, COP, CLP, ARS Experience working at: Global banks EM FX trading firms Payment / fintech companies Crypto exchanges or market makers Proven experience executing OTC and institutional-sized FX trades. Technical Expertise Deep understanding of: FX market microstructure in illiquid markets NDF markets and offshore hedging Capital controls and FX regulatory frameworks Hands-on experience building or optimizing: FX trading systems Hedging engines Liquidity aggregation platforms Familiarity with FIX connectivity, API-based trading systems, and algorithmic execution. Skills Strong quantitative and analytical capabilities. Ability to operate in high-volatility and fragmented liquidity environments. Strong network within EM FX liquidity providers and OTC trading desks. Excellent communication and cross-functional collaboration skills. Preferred Qualifications Experience supporting high-volume cross-border payment flows or treasury operations. Experience trading EM FX through both traditional banks and alternative liquidity sources. Familiarity with stablecoin / crypto liquidity markets in emerging economies. Background in building or scaling FX market-making operations. Strong analytical and problem solving skills Ability to operate across global teams and fast paced environments Vision & Mission OSL is the first SFC-licensed digital asset platform in Hong Kong and a PayFi innovator. Through stablecoin payments, cross-border settlement and global licensing, we are building the next-generation payments network. Stablecoins have become everyday money across emerging markets and are widely viewed as blockchain’s “killer app,” with industry focus shifting from token issuance to real-world consumer and enterprise payment adoption. The strongest growth lies in cross-border B2B payments, where providers embedding stablecoins into corporate settlement flows can capture significant volume and float. Long-term defensibility comes from regulatory licences, banking partners and cross-border corridors. OSL holds or has acquired licences in Hong Kong, Japan, Australia, Bermuda and Indonesia, and is expanding into Europe, Brazil, Southeast Asia and Africa through acquisitions and licence applications. With OSL Pay and StableX, we embed stablecoin settlement into bank accounts and card networks, support 150+ digital assets, and provide 24/7 fiat–stablecoin conversion. As a regulated pioneer with a startup mindset, we believe the future of payments will be driven by real adoption and scalable deployment, not technology narratives. We welcome builders who are passionate about crypto and payments to join us in shaping compliant, global payment infrastructure.

Nossa missão é tornar o cuidado de saúde acessível a todos, em qualquer lugar e a qualquer momento. Combinando tecnologia de ponta e conhecimento médico, estamos moldando o futuro da saúde e proporcionando impacto positivo na vida de milhões de pessoas. *O QUE PROCURAMOS: * Você será responsável por realizar consultas por vídeo e telefone, por intermédio de plataforma do empregador, atendendo na especialidade de Gastroenterologia, de forma ética, com abordagem biopsicossocial do processo saúde-adoecimento, integrando ações de prevenção, promoção, proteção, recuperação e educação em saúde buscando alcançar os melhores resultados clínicos;
PAPEIS E RESPONSABILIDADES Fornecer atendimento médico especializado em gastroenterologia de forma remota, através de consultas e avaliações realizadas por meio de plataformas digitais de comunicação. Experiência e conhecimento para o diagnóstico, tratamento e acompanhamento de pacientes com doenças e distúrbios gastrointestinais. Realizar consultas em Telemedicina sendo capaz de: conduzir anamneses virtuais para coletar queixas e histórico médico, realizar exame clínico e avaliações do sistema gastrointestinal à distância, interpretar resultados de exames laboratoriais, endoscópicos e de imagem, elaborar diagnósticos precisos, propor medidas terapêuticas e orientações de cuidado, reconhecer sinais de gravidade em gastroenterologia e critérios para encaminhar ao atendimento presencial. Atuar de forma a priorizar a prática médica centrada na pessoa. Elaborar planos de tratamento individualizados, levando em consideração as necessidades específicas de cada paciente. Ser hábil na prescrição de medicamentos adequados para tratar doenças gastrointestinais. Recomendar alterações no estilo de vida, dieta e hábitos alimentares para melhorar a saúde digestiva. Monitorar o progresso dos pacientes ao longo do tratamento em telemedicina. Realizar ajustes no plano de tratamento, conforme necessário, com base na resposta do paciente ao tratamento. Desenvolver atividades integrais de saúde, incorporando prevenção e promoção de saúde para dar as respostas mais adequadas às necessidades de saúde apresentadas. Atender com elevado grau de qualidade, sendo resolutivo na grande maioria das orientações acerca de problemas de saúde gastrointestinais. Considerar os valores e preferências pessoais do paciente conjuntamente às melhores evidências científicas e à experiência de manejo clínico para efetivamente promover a melhor prática clínica e os melhores desfechos em saúde para cada indivíduo. Exercer uso racional de recursos em saúde visando a segurança do paciente e a prevenção quaternária, evitando sobrediagnóstico e sobretratamento, que expõe os indivíduos a maiores riscos do que benefícios em saúde. Estimular a participação e a autonomia dos indivíduos e familiares, fortalecendo a aderência a tratamentos e medidas de autocuidado. Documentar todas as interações e informações relevantes dos pacientes em prontuários eletrônicos seguros e confidenciais. Manter-se bem-informado e atualizado, ampliando sua própria competência em relação a conhecimentos sobre riscos em saúde e sobre as medidas mais eficientes para eliminar ou reduzir os riscos relevantes. ou comprovante de matrícula em Residência médica. Pós ou Especialização na área;

Experiência ematividades relacionadas à atuação em atendimento médico na Atenção Primária à Saúde;
Conhecimentos Específicos para a função: Prestar orientações personalizadas a indivíduos e suas famílias com conhecimentos para o diagnóstico, tratamento e acompanhamento de pacientes com doenças e distúrbios gastrointestinais. About the Product Anterior is on a mission to transform healthcare administration, making it seamless and invisible so clinicians can focus on delivering care. We’ve built an AI-powered platform designed by clinicians, for clinicians, to simplify administrative workflows and improve patient outcomes. By combining clinical expertise with cutting-edge technology, we’re revolutionizing healthcare operations with responsible AI. We’re growing rapidly and are backed by world-class investors including Sequoia, New Enterprise Associates NEA, and Neo along with notable angels including the founders of DeepMind, Google AI, and Inflection AI. Anterior is improving the experience of healthcare for everyone. We’re working on the cutting edge of using technology to make clinical decision-making frictionless.We’re building exciting tech for huge customers and we trust in the foundations: keep it simple, build strong foundations, and the rest will follow. The Team At Anterior, engineers share a strong “sense of product” and solve meaningful problems that simplify healthcare workflows. We collaborate in multidisciplinary teams to deliver secure, scalable, and user-focused solutions guided by best practices and modular design. We’re building a dedicated deployments team focused on deploying our platform into large US enterprise healthcare environments. This team works closely with customers and our core platform engineers to ensure seamless, reliable integrations into complex payer systems of record. About You You have a passion for doing things The Right Way, you believe Less is More, you want to focus on the foundations of system design and architecture (pacelc, consistency guarantees), you care as much about the code you do not write, you’re tired of the hype treadmill and care about the fundamentals. You have battle scars from over-engineered and underperforming slop, and you care about writing code that lasts. Your depth is in building integrations, APIs, and data pipelines that connect complex systems together reliably. You’ve worked with enterprise customers, dealt with messy data, conflicting sources of truth, and deduplication challenges. You’ve owned integration design decisions end-to-end — from scoping requirements with a customer to shipping it to production and making sure it holds up. You may be coming from a health tech company, a scale-up doing enterprise deployments, or a platform team that built the connective tissue between systems — what matters is that you’ve navigated real integration complexity and you want ownership over what you build. About the Role Members of Technical Staff (Deployments) at Anterior own customer deployment problems end-to-end — from scoping integrations through to production. You’ll be the bridge between our AI platform and the enterprise healthcare systems it plugs into. A day’s work may include: Designing and building integrations, APIs, and data pipelines that connect our platform to customer systems of record EHRs, claims platforms, care management systems) Working directly with US enterprise healthcare customers to understand their architecture, scope integration requirements, and translate them into technical specs Building and maintaining FHIR, HL7, and custom API integrations with payer and health plan systems Debugging data quality issues — conflicting sources of truth, deduplication, schema mismatches, and edge cases specific to healthcare data Owning UAT testing end-to-end, working with customer IT teams to validate data flows before go-live Building internal tooling and shared integration patterns that make the next deployment faster Contributing to Anterior’s SDKs, developer documentation, and integration playbooks Collaborating closely with the core platform team in New York to ensure integration needs inform platform architecture Tech Langs: Python / TS Infra: Nix, AWS Healthcare data: FHIR, HL7 (experience preferred but not required — you’ll learn fast if you have strong API and data pipeline fundamentals) What we’re looking for Strong backend engineering fundamentals — APIs, data pipelines, distributed systems Experience integrating with enterprise systems, ideally in healthcare (payer, EHR, claims) but complex enterprise integrations in other industries count too Comfort working directly with customers and translating ambiguous requirements into clean technical solutions Experience with data quality challenges — deduplication, schema mapping, reconciliation across multiple sources of truth Strong written and spoken communication in English — you’ll be collaborating with teams and customers across time zones Ability to work autonomously from detailed technical specs while flagging blockers and ambiguity early Timezone compatibility with US East Coast ET) working hours What’s in it for you This is an opportunity to join a company at its major inflection point, using cutting- edge technology to have a meaningful impact in healthcare. You’ll work with a world-class team, hold significant responsibility, and have the opportunity to learn and grow rapidly. We offer We welcome new ideas and allow you to make an immediate impact on the team. Flexible Paid time off (PTO for any reason, including sick days (no specified limits) and flexible work schedule). Personal laptop. Health and wellness package. Fully remote. As this is an English-speaking role, we kindly ask that all applications be submitted with a CV in English.

This TPM will drive program execution across cross-functional teams—translating product intent into clear plans, predictable delivery, and measurable outcomes—while ensuring work is well-managed in GitHub (where our PM workflows now live). This role is ideal for someone who thrives at the intersection of product, engineering, and operations—bringing structure, visibility, and momentum to complex initiatives, and enabling the PM to focus on customer and market discovery.
- Own end-to-end program management for multiple digital commerce initiatives, from intake through delivery and rollout.

- Drive delivery rituals: standups, sprint/iteration planning support, backlog readiness, dependency reviews, status reporting, and go/no-go readiness.

escalate with context and options, not just problems.
- Ensure clear communication across teams and leadership with concise updates and action-oriented readouts.
- Help standardize how initiatives are tracked in GitHub (e.G., issues, epics, project boards, milestones), driving consistent hygiene and visibility.
- Improve team throughput by reducing friction in processes and tooling (templates, workflows, reporting, intake).
- Identify opportunities to use AI-enabled workflows to reduce overhead (e.G., release comms drafting, backlog grooming support, automated status summaries, incident triage workflows, documentation acceleration) while maintaining governance and quality.
- Partner with engineering and product to implement pragmatic automation that improves delivery efficiency.
- Coordinate release plans across teams: readiness checklists, rollout sequencing, communication plans, training/support readiness, and post-launch monitoring.
- Ensure operational handoffs and documentation are complete for production support.

title: Linux Systems Engineer
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Linux Systems Engineer em lauro de freitas. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

Linux Systems Engineer Embedded, IoT & Edge Infrastructure DISCIPLINE: Embedded Linux SENIORITY: Mid · Senior EXPERIENCE: 3+ years STACK FOCUS: Yocto · WebKit 01 About the role We're looking for a Linux engineer with an investigative mindset and a solid foundation in embedded systems. Short term: take hardware from third-party signage vendors, understand what's running on it, adapt our player to run reliably on top. Longer term: build our own Yocto-based image from scratch — you'll be shaping that foundation too. 02 What you'll own Reverse engineer OS images from signage vendors — boot, drivers, app stack. Port our signage player across hardware targets (ARM, x86). Integrate OTA frameworks — SWUpdate, RAUC, A/B partition schemes. Build embedded Linux images (Yocto/OE) as we move to our own OS. Tune GPU drivers for smooth video and graphics on signage hardware. WebKit-based rendering (WPE WebKit, WebKitGTK) as primary runtime. Document ndings — BSP quirks, BIOS/UEFI behavior, integration procedures. Partner with the app team on player requirements and OS constraints. 03 What you bring MUST NON-NEGOTIABLE 3+ years with embedded or edge Linux. Linux boot process — BIOS/UEFI, U-Boot/GRUB, initrd, device tree. Yocto or Buildroot. OTA / update frameworks — SWUpdate, RAUC, A/B partitions. GPU driver integration — Mesa, Intel, AMD, ARM Mali/Vivante. Reverse engineering mindset — analyze and document an unfamiliar OS image. Shell, C/C++, Git. Comfortable with real hardware, not just VMs. NICE BONUS SIGNAL WebKit on embedded — WPE WebKit, WebKitGTK. Wayland / DRM-KMS display stack. Commercial signage hardware — LG webOS, Samsung Tizen, BrightSign. Docker, CI/CD pipelines. Firmware analysis — binwalk, Ghidra. Rust or Python. Networking — bridge, vlan, iptables, mDNS. Security hardening / secure boot. 04 The kind of engineer this work asks for Thinks like an investigator. Given an unknown device, knows where to pull threads. Documents findings, not just fixes. Leaves a trail for the team. Comfortable with ambiguity. At ease with projects still taking shape. Likes making things run cleanly.On hardware they weren't designed for APPLY Process run by a specialized technical consultancy. Candidates evaluated by engineers — real conversations, real hardware.

Show Ownership & Editorial Strategy Own multiple shows end-to-end, from pre-editorial planning to post-release optimization. Define show-level creative direction, narrative arcs, and long-term storytelling strategy. Review and approve concept notes, localization approaches, and adaptation frameworks. Review outputs, provide constructive feedback, and ensure consistent quality across the team. Drive accountability, productivity, and skill development within the team. Continuously optimize content to maximize engagement and platform growth. 5. Production Collaboration & Quality Control Provide feedback on voice-over, production quality, and final audio output. Ensure alignment between scripts and produced audio content. Collaborate with production, QC, and creative teams to maintain high-quality output. 6. Stakeholder Collaboration Work closely with business, content, and production teams to align on show goals and performance targets. Qualifications Bachelor’s degree in Literature, Creative Writing, Media, Communications, or a related field. Proven experience in scriptwriting, content localization, or storytelling for audio/video platforms. Strong leadership experience managing writers or creative teams. Deep understanding of narrative structure, pacing, and audience engagement strategies. Experience working with AI-based writing/adaptation tools is preferred. Strong analytical skills with the ability to interpret performance data and drive decisions. Excellent communication, feedback, and stakeholder management skills. Ability to manage multiple shows and deadlines in a fast-paced environment. Key Traits for Success Strong ownership mindset with end-to-end accountability for show performance Ability to think from a user perspective and solve content challenges creatively Leadership and mentoring capability to build high-performing writing teams Understanding and crafting the workflow as new challenges arise Balance of creativity and data-driven decision-making

Trading Infrastructure & Systems Work closely with engineering and product teams to build and enhance FX trading and hedging infrastructure, including: Automated hedging engines Liquidity aggregation systems Smart order routing Pricing and risk management tools Integrate connectivity with banks, ECNs, and liquidity providers via APIs or FIX protocols. Improve execution automation, latency optimization, and real-time exposure monitoring. Market Development Identify and onboard new liquidity providers and OTC trading partners across emerging markets. Build pricing frameworks for illiquid currency pairs and support new corridor launches. Contribute to the development of scalable FX infrastructure supporting global payments and settlement flows. Requirements Experience 5–10+ years of FX trading experience in Emerging Markets. Strong experience trading African or LATAM currencies, such as: Africa: NGN, KES, ZAR, GHS, EGP LATAM: BRL, MXN, COP, CLP, ARS Experience working at: Global banks EM FX trading firms Payment / fintech companies Crypto exchanges or market makers Proven experience executing OTC and institutional-sized FX trades. Technical Expertise Deep understanding of: FX market microstructure in illiquid markets NDF markets and offshore hedging Capital controls and FX regulatory frameworks Hands-on experience building or optimizing: FX trading systems Hedging engines Liquidity aggregation platforms Familiarity with FIX connectivity, API-based trading systems, and algorithmic execution. Skills Strong quantitative and analytical capabilities. Ability to operate in high-volatility and fragmented liquidity environments. Strong network within EM FX liquidity providers and OTC trading desks. Excellent communication and cross-functional collaboration skills. Preferred Qualifications Experience supporting high-volume cross-border payment flows or treasury operations. Experience trading EM FX through both traditional banks and alternative liquidity sources. Familiarity with stablecoin / crypto liquidity markets in emerging economies. Background in building or scaling FX market-making operations. Strong analytical and problem solving skills Ability to operate across global teams and fast paced environments Vision & Mission OSL is the first SFC-licensed digital asset platform in Hong Kong and a PayFi innovator. Through stablecoin payments, cross-border settlement and global licensing, we are building the next-generation payments network. Stablecoins have become everyday money across emerging markets and are widely viewed as blockchain’s “killer app,” with industry focus shifting from token issuance to real-world consumer and enterprise payment adoption. The strongest growth lies in cross-border B2B payments, where providers embedding stablecoins into corporate settlement flows can capture significant volume and float. Long-term defensibility comes from regulatory licences, banking partners and cross-border corridors. OSL holds or has acquired licences in Hong Kong, Japan, Australia, Bermuda and Indonesia, and is expanding into Europe, Brazil, Southeast Asia and Africa through acquisitions and licence applications. With OSL Pay and StableX, we embed stablecoin settlement into bank accounts and card networks, support 150+ digital assets, and provide 24/7 fiat–stablecoin conversion. As a regulated pioneer with a startup mindset, we believe the future of payments will be driven by real adoption and scalable deployment, not technology narratives. We welcome builders who are passionate about crypto and payments to join us in shaping compliant, global payment infrastructure.

title: Médico Pediatra
description:

Nosso time de médicos desempenham um papel crucial no suporte dos pacientes, para sanar suas dúvidas, atender as demandas de saúde de acordo com a necessidade de cada um, através de nossa plataforma online. Se você é um profissional licenciado, focado em resultados e apaixonado por fazer a diferença na vida dos pacientes, queremos conhecer você! O médico será responsável por realizar consultas por vídeo e telefone, por intermédio de plataforma do empregador, na modalidade especialidade em Pediatria, de forma ética, com abordagem biopsicossocial do processo saúde-adoecimento, integrando ações de prevenção, promoção, proteção, recuperação e educação em saúde buscando alcançar os melhores resultados clínicos;
PAPEL E RESPONSABILIDADES Fornecer atendimento médico especializado em Pediatria de forma remota, através de consultas e avaliações realizadas por meio de plataformas digitais de comunicação. Experiência e conhecimento para o diagnóstico, tratamento e acompanhamento de crianças e adolescentes em suas múltiplas facetas e condições. Realizar consultas em Telemedicina sendo capaz de conduzir anamnese virtual para coletar queixas e histórico médico, realizar exame clínico e avaliações à distância, interpretar resultados de exames laboratoriais e de imagem, elaborar diagnósticos precisos, propor medidas terapêuticas e orientações de cuidado, reconhecer sinais de risco e gravidade em Pediatria e critérios para encaminhar ao atendimento presencial. Competência na avaliação pediátrica, incluindo o reconhecimento de problemas e doenças que possam estar presente nesta faixa etária. Habilidade em conduzir entrevistas detalhadas e observar sintomas e sinais através de vídeochamada com o responsável. Atuar de forma a priorizar a prática médica centrada na pessoa. Elaborar planos de tratamento individualizados, levando em consideração as necessidades específicas de cada paciente. Ser hábil na prescrição de medicamentos adequados para tratar doenças de acordo com o diagnóstico e faixa etária. Monitorar o progresso dos pacientes ao longo do tratamento em telemedicina. Realizar ajustes no plano de tratamento, conforme necessário, com base na resposta do paciente ao tratamento. Desenvolver atividades integrais de saúde, incorporando prevenção e promoção de saúde para dar as respostas mais adequadas às necessidades de saúde da criança e do adolescente. Atender com elevado grau de qualidade, sendo resolutivo na grande maioria das orientações acerca dos principais problemas de saúde em Pediatria. Garantir o respeito ao ECA (Estatuto da Criança e do Adolescente) com respeito aos seus direitos e prerrogativas para o cuidado em saúde. Realizar consulta individualizada ao adolescente sem necessidade de responsável a partir dos 12 anos de idade conforme previsto pelo ECA (Estatuto da Criança e do Adolescente), caso solicitado ou quando avaliada necessária. Considerar os valores e preferências pessoais do paciente conjuntamente às melhores evidências científicas e à experiência de manejo clínico para efetivamente promover a melhor prática clínica e os melhores desfechos em saúde para cada indivíduo. Exercer uso racional de recursos em saúde visando a segurança do paciente e a prevenção quaternária, evitando sobrediagnóstico e sobretratamento, que expõe crianças e adolescentes a maiores riscos do que benefícios em saúde. Estimular a participação e a autonomia dos indivíduos e familiares, fortalecendo a aderência a tratamentos e medidas de autocuidado. Documentar todas as interações e informações relevantes dos pacientes em prontuários eletrônicos seguros e confidenciais. Ter capacidade de crítica de sua própria atividade médica, considerando-a em seus aspectos científicos, éticos e sociais para aprimoramento contínuo. Manter-se bem-informado e atualizado, ampliando sua própria competência em relação a conhecimentos sobre riscos em saúde e sobre as medidas mais eficientes para eliminar ou reduzir os riscos relevantes. Respeitar, cumprir e fazer cumprir os ditames do Código de Ética Médica, bem como a Legislação vigente e os regulamentos internos formais da Instituição. Certificado Digital Ativo reconhecido pela Infraestrutura de Chaves Públicas Brasileira (ICP-Brasil). Experiência: Experiência em atividades relacionadas à atuação em atendimento médico em Pediatria, sendo desejável experiência prévia em Telemedicina e Atenção Primária à Saúde;
Conhecimentos Específicos para a função: Médico competente em prestar orientações personalizadas a indivíduos e suas famílias com conhecimentos para o diagnóstico, tratamento e acompanhamento de Crianças e Adolescentes. Competências Comportamentais: Médico comprometido com os pacientes, com ideais e valores da empresa, apresentando postura ética, pontualidade, capacidade de integração com equipe multiprofissional. Outros Requisitos Importantes: Conhecimentos e Habilidades em computação: uso do Pacote Office (Excel, Word, Power Point, Gráficos) e Internet. Familiaridade com tecnologias de telemedicina e uso de plataformas de comunicação virtual é um diferencial desejável. Local de Trabalho: O Médico atuará remotamente, conduzindo suas atividades a partir de seu próprio consultório ou local de preferência, através da telemedicina. IMPORTANTE: MODELO DE CONTRATAÇÃO: Contratação em regime de Prestador de Serviços por contrato Pessoa Jurídica, necessário fazer parte como representante legal ou sócio de um CNPJ ativo. REMUNERAÇÃO E AGENDAMENTOS : a negociar durante processo seletivo. title: Landholder And Reforestation Delivery Manager
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Landholder And Reforestation Delivery Manager em camaçari. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar. About NatureCo NatureCo delivers nature-based solutions (NbS) for investors, corporates and other purpose driven organisations to scale up action on climate change and biodiversity loss. We specialise in nature-based project development including reforestation, agroforestry, farmer managed natural regeneration and mangrove restoration. NatureCo has extensive expertise in working with local communities to protect and restore natural ecosystems through participation in the global voluntary carbon market. NatureCo is currently implementing a large-scale reforestation project in Brazil for the generation of verified carbon credits. We are a diverse, mission-driven team that values inclusion, integrity, and innovation. NatureCo is proud to be an Equal Opportunity Employer, committed to building an equitable and inclusive workplace for all. Role and responsibilities The Landholder and Reforestation Delivery Manager is the primary field-based interface with landholders, communities, reforestation contractors, and other local stakeholders for NatureCo’s projects in Brazil. This position will build and manage a pipeline of landholders interested in reforestation, lead outreach and onboarding, coordinate site inspections, lead the collection of relevant data required for carbon standard checks, and lead signature of landholder agreements. The role will also play a key role in ensuring compliance (contracts and carbon standards) as well as coordinate schedules between landholders and contractors for the implementation of reforestation activities. This will include confirming site readiness, conducting periodic field quality audits, documenting and tracking progress, and resolving issues that could delay delivery or degrade quality. The role requires a strong combination stakeholder engagement and management experience, and a commitment to quality and impact. The role requires extensive travel and field work across Minas Gerais, Bahia and Espírito Santo. Primary roles and responsibilities include: Landholder engagement, onboarding, and pipeline management Map priority municipalities and referral partner networks (city governments, co-ops, farmer associations, NGOs);
plan and run outreach activities, events and information sessions. Manage the landholder onboarding process (identify → qualify → onboard → contract), using CRM/trackers to keep status, documents and next actions current. Prepare clear information packs (benefits, obligations, timelines) and respond to inquiries in a timely, professional manner. Maintain ongoing landholder relationship management to support retention, satisfaction, and smooth site access throughout implementation. Eligibility, due diligence & agreements Coordinate site inspections and initial diagnostics in consultation with other team members (parcel boundaries, vegetation status, access, water, risks). Support land tenure verification and FPIC documentation Lead closure of contract signatures. Maintain organized repository of all landholder records within NatureCo’s data management system (land titles, eligibility documents, contracts, site maps, inspection notes, photos, consultation records). Reforestation delivery enablement Translate signed landholder agreements into implementation-ready site plans (site-specific scope, access instructions, constraints, schedule windows). Align field schedules with landholders and contractors to ensure access, minimize disruption to farm activities, and maintain trust and cooperation. Support in the delivery of field delivery progress from contractors by site (start/finish dates, activities completed, challenges, next steps), and escalate issues early (access, weather delays, input shortages, labor constraints). Support in monitoring reforestation activities (during and post planting) and coordinate, where required, rapid response with contractors/landholders (grazing, fire risk, pests, drought stress). Stakeholder engagement and safeguards Plan and document stakeholder consultations and community meetings in accordance with NatureCo policies and procedures (agendas, attendance lists, minutes, photos). Support the team in the operation of the grievance mechanism: receiving grievances and responding in accordance with the NatureCo grievance mechanism. Maintain landholder contact and ensure landholder information is kept up to date. Coordinate access, for other project staff and contractors as required. Reporting Lead or assist the development of formal monthly, quarterly, and annual project implementation reports for internal and external stakeholders in line with contract and/or carbon standard requirements. Prepare ad hoc reports, documents, and presentations for internal and external stakeholders. Teamwork and culture Support the management of a cross-functional, international team, fostering collaboration and ensuring that project milestones and goals are met. Stay current on emerging best practices in NbS and carbon projects;
proactively share insights across the organisation and with partners. Skills and attributes To perform successfully in this role, you will have: A minimum of five (5) years of experience in reforestation projects with direct contact with rural landholders and reforestation planting service providers. Degree in forest engineering, agronomy, ecology, or environmental science. Intermediate English and native Portuguese language skills Excellent written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to engage confidently across cultures and stakeholder groups. Strong project management skills, including experience managing timelines, deliverables, and working across multidisciplinary teams. A proactive, self-starting approach with the ability to anticipate problems, adapt quickly, and take initiative under limited supervision. A collaborative mindset and ability to lead and motivate internal teams and external partners Ability to provide strategic and technical guidance across complex, multi-stakeholder projects. Strong organisational skills and attention to detail in documentation and reporting. A positive, energetic personality with resilience and drive to see projects through to delivery. Extensive travel within Brazil is a requirement to perform this position. Location Remote, with residence in Minas Gerais, Espirito Santo, or Bahia Submission instructions Email CV and brief cover letter to with subject: Landholder and Reforestation Delivery Manager Submission deadline: 30 March 2026

Longer term: build our own Yocto-based image from scratch — you'll be shaping that foundation too. 02 What you'll own Reverse engineer OS images from signage vendors — boot, drivers, app stack. Port our signage player across hardware targets (ARM, x86). Integrate OTA frameworks — SWUpdate, RAUC, A/B partition schemes. Build embedded Linux images (Yocto/OE) as we move to our own OS. Tune GPU drivers for smooth video and graphics on signage hardware. WebKit-based rendering (WPE WebKit, WebKitGTK) as primary runtime. Document ndings — BSP quirks, BIOS/UEFI behavior, integration procedures. Partner with the app team on player requirements and OS constraints. 03 What you bring MUST NON-NEGOTIABLE 3+ years with embedded or edge Linux. Linux boot process — BIOS/UEFI, U-Boot/GRUB, initrd, device tree. Yocto or Buildroot. OTA / update frameworks — SWUpdate, RAUC, A/B partitions. GPU driver integration — Mesa, Intel, AMD, ARM Mali/Vivante. Reverse engineering mindset — analyze and document an unfamiliar OS image. Shell, C/C++, Git. Comfortable with real hardware, not just VMs. NICE BONUS SIGNAL WebKit on embedded — WPE WebKit, WebKitGTK. Wayland / DRM-KMS display stack. Commercial signage hardware — LG webOS, Samsung Tizen, BrightSign. Docker, CI/CD pipelines. Firmware analysis — binwalk, Ghidra. Rust or Python. Networking — bridge, vlan, iptables, mDNS. Security hardening / secure boot. 04 The kind of engineer this work asks for Thinks like an investigator. Given an unknown device, knows where to pull threads. Documents findings, not just fixes. Leaves a trail for the team. Comfortable with ambiguity. At ease with projects still taking shape. Likes making things run cleanly.On hardware they weren't designed for APPLY Process run by a specialized technical consultancy. Candidates evaluated by engineers — real conversations, real hardware.

description:

Do you love to read, write, and analyze things? Are you a detailed and accurate notetaker? Can you type both fast and accurately? Are you not satisfied with your current job or career and willing to start from the beginning to build your career in a company that has an abundance of opportunities to learn and grow your knowledge, career, and income? Do you seek to develop your leadership skills and build a career related to Human Resources and Labor Law? Would you describe yourself as someone who has a strong eye for detail? Do you have experience working independently and managing your time effectively in a home office setting? Are you a curious person with an analytical mind who gets excited about the pursuit of solving a mystery in the context of employee discrimination/harassment complaint investigations? Are you someone who thrives in environments that offer continuous change, challenge, learning, and growth opportunities? If you answered YES to all the above questions, this may be the perfect opportunity for you to join our amazing team! About California Labor Solutions California Labor Solutions (CLS) is a growing workplace investigation and human resource (HR) management company located in California, USA. CLS provides HR services, such as consulting, executive search/recruitment, and employee complaint investigations, to other organizations throughout California. We help organizations become more successful by strategically supporting them to manage their workforce and the relevant employment regulations. What are Workplace (Employee Complaint) Investigations? In the U.S., when an employee files a complaint about harassment, discrimination, or retaliation, the organization is legally obligated to investigate it. Some are handled internally, and others require an external investigator to ensure impartiality… that’s where CLS comes in! Assistants support the Investigator during the investigation process, including interviews with the employee who filed the complaint, relevant witnesses, and the accused, taking interview notes, and gathering the evidence. Then, we analyze all the testimonies and evidence and reach a factual finding of whether the alleged conduct happened and, if so, whether it violated any of the company’s policies. We are hiring for either an HR & Investigation Assistant OR an HR & Investigation Specialist. Amazing Compensation, Benefits, and Bonuses: Compensation: HUMAN RESOURCES & INVESTIGATION ASSISTANT (Position Open Now): The total monthly compensation range is $3,500 BRL to $7,000 BRL. This includes benefits which are: · Gym membership support: $105 BRL · Private health insurance support: $265 BRL · Home office and phone/high-speed internet service support: $160 BRL Starting monthly base compensation depends on the level and quality of your work experience relevant to the work CLS performs AND possession of both required and preferred qualifications. Every six months, you will receive a performance review and compensation increase of up to $700 BRL, depending on your performance, until it reaches the maximum compensation range for the position. As an HR & Investigation Assistant, you may become eligible for promotion to the HR & Investigation Specialist position after a minimum of 12 months, during which time advanced core competencies required to perform the work are established. HUMAN RESOURCES & INVESTIGATION SPECIALIST (Position Open Now): The total monthly compensation range is $7,000 BRL - $11,000 BRL. The total compensation amount includes benefits which are: · Gym membership support: $105 BRL · Private health insurance support: $265 BRL · Home office and phone/high-speed internet service support: $160 BRL Starting monthly compensation will be between $7,000 BRL to $8,500 BRL depending on your work experience relevant to the work CLS performs, possession of both required and preferred qualifications and your performance on the assessments in the hiring process. Every six months, you will receive a performance review and compensation increase of up to $700 BRL, depending on your performance, until it reaches the maximum compensation range for the position. Additional Compensation & High-Performance Bonus Opportunities - Such as: · High-performance bonus: When you perform investigations work, every investigation that you complete from start to finish according to CLS protocols and without major errors, you will receive a bonus of $700 BRL. That is $700 BRL for the person assisting the investigator AND another $700 BRL for the senior writer (person co-leading the project and performing the final review.) description:

Role Overview We are seeking a highly skilled Emerging Markets FX Trader with deep expertise in African and/or Latin American currencies to join our global trading & liquidity team. The ideal candidate will have extensive experience managing illiquid and restricted FX markets, executing OTC and interbank trades, and designing robust hedging and liquidity frameworks to support high-volume cross-border payment flows. This role requires both strong trading capability and infrastructure expertise, including building and optimizing FX trading systems, hedging engines, and liquidity connectivity with banks, brokers, and OTC counterparties. Key Responsibilities FX Trading & Liquidity Management Manage proprietary and flow-driven FX trading positions across Emerging Market currencies, with a focus on African (e.G., NGN, KES, ZAR, GHS) or LATAM (e.G., BRL, MXN, COP, ARS) markets. Source and maintain deep liquidity relationships with banks, brokers, and OTC desks across relevant regions. Execute spot, forwards, NDFs, swaps, and OTC trades to optimize execution quality and manage currency exposure. Monitor market developments, capital controls, and liquidity dynamics across EM FX markets. Hedging Strategy & Risk Management Design and implement FX hedging strategies to manage corporate or client-driven exposures. Optimize hedging efficiency across multiple liquidity venues including banks, ECNs, OTC desks, and crypto liquidity pools where relevant. Develop models for dynamic hedging, inventory risk management, and spread optimization. Monitor risk limits, PnL, and exposure across currency books. Trading Infrastructure & Systems Work closely with engineering and product teams to build and enhance FX trading and hedging infrastructure, including: Automated hedging engines Liquidity aggregation systems Smart order routing Pricing and risk management tools Integrate connectivity with banks, ECNs, and liquidity providers via APIs or FIX protocols. Improve execution automation, latency optimization, and real-time exposure monitoring. Market Development Identify and onboard new liquidity providers and OTC trading partners across emerging markets. Build pricing frameworks for illiquid currency pairs and support new corridor launches. Contribute to the development of scalable FX infrastructure supporting global payments and settlement flows. Requirements Experience 5–10+ years of FX trading experience in Emerging Markets. Strong experience trading African or LATAM currencies, such as: Africa: NGN, KES, ZAR, GHS, EGP LATAM: BRL, MXN, COP, CLP, ARS Experience working at: Global banks EM FX trading firms Payment / fintech companies Crypto exchanges or market makers Proven experience executing OTC and institutional-sized FX trades. Technical Expertise Deep understanding of: FX market microstructure in illiquid markets NDF markets and offshore hedging Capital controls and FX regulatory frameworks Hands-on experience building or optimizing: FX trading systems Hedging engines Liquidity aggregation platforms Familiarity with FIX connectivity, API-based trading systems, and algorithmic execution. Skills Strong quantitative and analytical capabilities. Ability to operate in high-volatility and fragmented liquidity environments. Strong network within EM FX liquidity providers and OTC trading desks. Excellent communication and cross-functional collaboration skills. Preferred Qualifications Experience supporting high-volume cross-border payment flows or treasury operations. Experience trading EM FX through both traditional banks and alternative liquidity sources. Familiarity with stablecoin / crypto liquidity markets in emerging economies. Background in building or scaling FX market-making operations. Strong analytical and problem solving skills Ability to operate across global teams and fast paced environments Vision & Mission OSL is the first SFC-licensed digital asset platform in Hong Kong and a PayFi innovator. Through stablecoin payments, cross-border settlement and global licensing, we are building the next-generation payments network. Stablecoins have become everyday money across emerging markets and are widely viewed as blockchain’s “killer app,” with industry focus shifting from token issuance to real-world consumer and enterprise payment adoption. The strongest growth lies in cross-border B2B payments, where providers embedding stablecoins into corporate settlement flows can capture significant volume and float. Long-term defensibility comes from regulatory licences, banking partners and cross-border corridors. OSL holds or has acquired licences in Hong Kong, Japan, Australia, Bermuda and Indonesia, and is expanding into Europe, Brazil, Southeast Asia and Africa through acquisitions and licence applications. With OSL Pay and StableX, we embed stablecoin settlement into bank accounts and card networks, support 150+ digital assets, and provide 24/7 fiat–stablecoin conversion. As a regulated pioneer with a startup mindset, we believe the future of payments will be driven by real adoption and scalable deployment, not technology narratives. We welcome builders who are passionate about crypto and payments to join us in shaping compliant, global payment infrastructure.

title: Landholder And Reforestation Delivery Manager
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Landholder And Reforestation Delivery Manager em feira de santana. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar. About NatureCo NatureCo delivers nature-based solutions (NbS) for investors, corporates and other purpose driven organisations to scale up action on climate change and biodiversity loss. We specialise in nature-based project development including reforestation, agroforestry, farmer managed natural regeneration and mangrove restoration. NatureCo has extensive expertise in working with local communities to protect and restore natural ecosystems through participation in the global voluntary carbon market. NatureCo is currently implementing a large-scale reforestation project in Brazil for the generation of verified carbon credits. We are a diverse, mission-driven team that values inclusion, integrity, and innovation. NatureCo is proud to be an Equal Opportunity Employer, committed to building an equitable and inclusive workplace for all. Role and responsibilities The Landholder and Reforestation Delivery Manager is the primary field-based interface with landholders, communities, reforestation contractors, and other local stakeholders for NatureCo’s projects in Brazil. This position will build and manage a pipeline of landholders interested in reforestation, lead outreach and onboarding, coordinate site inspections, lead the collection of relevant data required for carbon standard checks, and lead signature of landholder agreements. The role will also play a key role in ensuring compliance (contracts and carbon standards) as well as coordinate schedules between landholders and contractors for the implementation of reforestation activities. This will include confirming site readiness, conducting periodic field quality audits, documenting and tracking progress, and resolving issues that could delay delivery or degrade quality. The role requires a strong combination stakeholder engagement and management experience, and a commitment to quality and impact. The role requires extensive travel and field work across Minas Gerais, Bahia and Espírito Santo. Primary roles and responsibilities include: Landholder engagement, onboarding, and pipeline management Map priority municipalities and referral partner networks (city governments, co-ops, farmer associations, NGOs);
plan and run outreach activities, events and information sessions. Manage the landholder onboarding process (identify → qualify → onboard → contract), using CRM/trackers to keep status, documents and next actions current. Prepare clear information packs (benefits, obligations, timelines) and respond to inquiries in a timely, professional manner. Maintain ongoing landholder relationship management to support retention, satisfaction, and smooth site access throughout implementation. Eligibility, due diligence & agreements Coordinate site inspections and initial diagnostics in consultation with other team members (parcel boundaries, vegetation status, access, water, risks). Support land tenure verification and FPIC documentation Lead closure of contract signatures. Maintain organized repository of all landholder records within NatureCo’s data management system (land titles, eligibility documents, contracts, site maps, inspection notes, photos, consultation records). Reforestation delivery enablement Translate signed landholder agreements into implementation-ready site plans (site-specific scope, access instructions, constraints, schedule windows). Align field schedules with landholders and contractors to ensure access, minimize disruption to farm activities, and maintain trust and cooperation. Support in the delivery of field delivery progress from contractors by site (start/finish dates, activities completed, challenges, next steps), and escalate issues early (access, weather delays, input shortages, labor constraints). Support in monitoring reforestation activities (during and post planting) and coordinate, where required, rapid response with contractors/landholders (grazing, fire risk, pests, drought stress). Stakeholder engagement and safeguards Plan and document stakeholder consultations and community meetings in accordance with NatureCo policies and procedures (agendas, attendance lists, minutes, photos). Support the team in the operation of the grievance mechanism: receiving grievances and responding in accordance with the NatureCo grievance mechanism. Maintain landholder contact and ensure landholder information is kept up to date. Coordinate access, for other project staff and contractors as required. Reporting Lead or assist the development of formal monthly, quarterly, and annual project implementation reports for internal and external stakeholders in line with contract and/or carbon standard requirements. Prepare ad hoc reports, documents, and presentations for internal and external stakeholders. Teamwork and culture Support the management of a cross-functional, international team, fostering collaboration and ensuring that project milestones and goals are met. Stay current on emerging best practices in NbS and carbon projects;
proactively share insights across the organisation and with partners. Skills and attributes To perform successfully in this role, you will have: A minimum of five (5) years of experience in reforestation projects with direct contact with rural landholders and reforestation planting service providers. Degree in forest engineering, agronomy, ecology, or environmental science. Intermediate English and native Portuguese language skills Excellent written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to engage confidently across cultures and stakeholder groups. Strong project management skills, including experience managing timelines, deliverables, and working across multidisciplinary teams. A proactive, self-starting approach with the ability to anticipate problems, adapt quickly, and take initiative under limited supervision. A collaborative mindset and ability to lead and motivate internal teams and external partners Ability to provide strategic and technical guidance across complex, multi-stakeholder projects. Strong organisational skills and attention to detail in documentation and reporting. A positive, energetic personality with resilience and drive to see projects through to delivery. Extensive travel within Brazil is a requirement to perform this position. Location Remote, with residence in Minas Gerais, Espirito Santo, or Bahia Submission instructions Email CV and brief cover letter to with subject: Landholder and Reforestation Delivery Manager Submission deadline: 30 March 2026

description:

Backend Team Lead (PHP/Laravel) Location: Brazil (Remote) Our trusted high-growth healthcare technology partner is seeking a talented Backend Team Lead (PHP/Laravel) to join their dynamic team. This innovative company is dedicated to revolutionizing the healthcare industry through cutting-edge technology solutions. Position Overview As a Backend Team Lead, you will play a key role in leading the backend development team while contributing to the development and implementation of scalable and robust software solutions that support the company's mission and goals. You will guide and support the backend team while working closely with cross-functional teams to design, build, and maintain innovative applications and platforms that drive business success and improve patient outcomes. Primary Responsibilities Team Leadership: Lead and support the backend engineering team, ensuring effective collaboration, task distribution, and delivery of high-quality software. Platform Development: Spearhead the development and optimization of our EHR platform using PHP/Laravel, ensuring high performance, reliability, and scalability. Database Development: Creating database schemas that represent and support business processes. API Development and Integration: Develop and maintain APIs for internal and external use, facilitating seamless integration with other healthcare systems and third-party services. Security Compliance: Ensure the platform's compliance with healthcare industry standards, including HIPAA, by implementing and maintaining robust security measures and data protection protocols. Additional Responsibilities Mentor backend developers, providing guidance on best practices in backend development, code review, and team collaboration. Support the team in resolving technical challenges and ensure consistent development standards across the team. Stay abreast of new technology trends and evaluate their application to continually innovate and enhance the platform. Participate in an agile development environment, contributing to team coordination and iterative delivery processes, ensuring timely delivery of high-quality software. Competencies / Requirements Technical Expertise: Strong proficiency in PHP/Laravel and MySQL. Familiarity with version control tools, preferably Git. Experience: At least 6+ years of experience in backend development, with a proven track record of developing and maintaining scalable web applications. Previous experience leading or mentoring developers is required. Experience in the healthcare sector or EHR platforms is highly desirable. Problem-Solving Skills: Ability to tackle complex problems, think analytically, and develop innovative solutions. Communication Skills: Excellent verbal and written communication skills, capable of effectively collaborating with cross-functional teams and stakeholders. Attention to Detail: A strong focus on code quality, adherence to design specifications, and a commitment to creating a user-friendly, secure, and efficient platform. Benefits Competitive salary to recognize and reward your achievements. Flexible work environment. Opportunities for professional and personal growth.

description:
