At Syniti, we tackle the hardest work in data for the world’s largest organizations. As the industry’s only pure-play data company, we combine our Data First strategy, intelligent software and team of 100% data-focused experts to turn complex data initiatives into quantifiable business success. Trusted by the Fortune 2000, Syniti helps leading businesses reconfigure the role of enterprise data from afterthought to foundational first step;
enabling them to unlockvaluable insights that ignite growth, reduce risk, and expand their competitive advantage. We’ve enabled more than 5,000 successful projects and we’re a trusted partner for global enterprises and organizations throughout their data journeys. Syniti’s Data First philosophy and enterprise data management platform supports data migration, data quality, data replication, data matching, master data management, analytics, data governance, and data strategy in a single, unified solution. THE ROLE The Lab Systems Architect plays a critical role in the success of Syniti’s Education Services department by designing, implementing, and maintaining technical lab environments that support both eLearning and instructor-led training. This role ensures the seamless operation of lab systems, supports integration with learning platforms, and collaborates cross-functionally to enhance system workflows and user experience. The ideal candidate is a technically skilled, detail-oriented problem solver with a passion for enabling learning through robust infrastructure. WHAT YOU WILL DO Learning Lab Architecture & Management Provide technical oversight for the design, testing, provisioning, and implementation of Learning Lab environments. Manage and maintain lab snapshots, resolving configuration defects as they arise. Optimize lab usage policies in collaboration with Education Coordinators and Leadership. Monitor VM usage reports and metrics, ensuring alignment with budget and demand. Support LMS system integrations as required. Serve as the primary escalation point for lab-related issues and liaise with solution providers to resolve complex problems across all learning lab platforms. System Administration & Support Allocate and reset user training accounts. Stay current with new feature releases across all education platforms. Provide on-call support for lab systems used in global training programs, including availability during evenings and weekends as needed. Regularly review help desk tickets to identify recurring issues, usage patterns, and knowledge gaps. Recommend targeted training, updated documentation, or additional support resources to proactively address common challenges and improve user experience. Train internal and partner instructors on lab systems. Cross-Functional Collaboration & Stakeholder Management Collaborate with Training Operations, Delivery Management, IT, and Application teams to improve workflows, system functionality, and user experience. Manage stakeholder expectations and requirements related to lab systems and processes. Identify and resolve cross-functional issues to ensure company-wide alignment on lab system needs. Reporting & Documentation Document system configurations, best practices, and technical procedures. Own and maintain the Education Services Revenue Report, providing monthly updates to Finance. Support the creation and maintenance of Education Services forms, lists, automations, and integrations, as required. WHAT IT TAKES Proficiency in SQL and at least one of the following databases: Oracle, MS SQL Server, IBM DB2, or MySQL. Experience managing hypervisor solutions and SaaS platform architecture. Knowledge of Microsoft Forms, Power Automate, Power BI, and SharePoint. Experience with Windows Server and Azure Active Directory. Understanding of the Software Development Life Cycle (SDLC). Strong technical writing and documentation skills. Excellent communication, collaboration, and stakeholder management abilities. Knowledge of GraphQL queries and mutations (preferred). Self-starter with a proactive approach to problem-solving. Ability to manage multiple priorities in a fast-paced environment. Passion for education technology and continuous improvement. Be fully aligned to our core values: Think Big - Be courageous and bold. Aspire to greatness. Relentlessly pursue market innovation. Set the standard by which others follow. Create solutions that have a meaningful impact. Solve the challenges our customers don’t know they have. Be Curious - Be a lifelong learner. Seek out new ideas to serve customers. Understand our competition and the world. Be permanently dissatisfied with the status quo. Challenge preconceptions. Focus on the future rather than yesterday. Take Action - Be the first. Don’t wait. Take accountability. Inspire others by doing. Fail fast and learn from mistakes. Make a difference every day. Stronger Together - Respect, trust and look out for each other. Celebrate diverse perspectives. Listen. Build connections and belonging. Act with integrity. Give back. One Syniti family. WHAT WE OFFER Trust in your talent. At Syniti you will find a supportive environment and access to learning tools, but micromanagement is not our style. Growth. We are growing rapidly and steadily solving the biggest challenges enterprise companies are faced with today. There was never a better time to join and grow with us. title: Linux Systems Engineer
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Linux Systems Engineer em feira de santana. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

Linux Systems Engineer Embedded, IoT & Edge Infrastructure DISCIPLINE: Embedded Linux SENIORITY: Mid · Senior EXPERIENCE: 3+ years STACK FOCUS: Yocto · WebKit 01 About the role We're looking for a Linux engineer with an investigative mindset and a solid foundation in embedded systems. Short term: take hardware from third-party signage vendors, understand what's running on it, adapt our player to run reliably on top. Longer term: build our own Yocto-based image from scratch — you'll be shaping that foundation too. 02 What you'll own Reverse engineer OS images from signage vendors — boot, drivers, app stack. Port our signage player across hardware targets (ARM, x86). Integrate OTA frameworks — SWUpdate, RAUC, A/B partition schemes. Build embedded Linux images (Yocto/OE) as we move to our own OS. Tune GPU drivers for smooth video and graphics on signage hardware. WebKit-based rendering (WPE WebKit, WebKitGTK) as primary runtime. Document ndings — BSP quirks, BIOS/UEFI behavior, integration procedures. Partner with the app team on player requirements and OS constraints. 03 What you bring MUST NON-NEGOTIABLE 3+ years with embedded or edge Linux. Linux boot process — BIOS/UEFI, U-Boot/GRUB, initrd, device tree. Yocto or Buildroot. OTA / update frameworks — SWUpdate, RAUC, A/B partitions. GPU driver integration — Mesa, Intel, AMD, ARM Mali/Vivante. Reverse engineering mindset — analyze and document an unfamiliar OS image. Shell, C/C++, Git. Comfortable with real hardware, not just VMs. NICE BONUS SIGNAL WebKit on embedded — WPE WebKit, WebKitGTK. Wayland / DRM-KMS display stack. Commercial signage hardware — LG webOS, Samsung Tizen, BrightSign. Docker, CI/CD pipelines. Firmware analysis — binwalk, Ghidra. Rust or Python. Networking — bridge, vlan, iptables, mDNS. Security hardening / secure boot. 04 The kind of engineer this work asks for Thinks like an investigator. Given an unknown device, knows where to pull threads. Documents findings, not just fixes. Leaves a trail for the team. Comfortable with ambiguity. At ease with projects still taking shape. Likes making things run cleanly.On hardware they weren't designed for APPLY Process run by a specialized technical consultancy. Candidates evaluated by engineers — real conversations, real hardware.

title: Parceiro De Vendas
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Parceiro De Vendas em feira de santana. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar. Seja um Parceiro Estratégico do Grupo AG Capital, a Primeira TaxTech do Brasil. Você é um consultor, comercial ou líder de negócios com acesso a decisores C-level? Quer oferecer aos seus clientes uma solução de alto impacto, sem custo inicial, e ainda gerar uma nova e significativa fonte de receita? O Grupo AG Tax Tech, a primeira e maior TaxTech do Brasil, está expandindo sua rede de Parceiros Estratégicos. Já recuperamos mais de R$ 8 bilhões em tributos para mais de 12.000 clientes, incluindo 15% das empresas listadas na B3, e queremos que você faça parte desta história de sucesso. Nossa missão é transformar a complexidade tributária brasileira em fluxo de caixa e compliance para as empresas, através de tecnologia proprietária e uma metodologia exclusiva. Para acelerar essa missão, buscamos parceiros que compartilhem da nossa visão e queiram crescer conosco. Quem Buscamos? O Parceiro Ideal em 3 Dimensões: 1) Expertise e Acesso a Clientes Estratégicos: Você é um especialista com reputação sólida em consultoria (contábil, tributária, RH), advocacia empresarial, tecnologia ou vendas;
Possui um relacionamento de confiança com CFOs, CHROs e CEOs de médias e grandes empresas, especialmente as de Lucro Presumido ou Real? Buscamos sua credibilidade e seu acesso ao mercado. 2) Alinhamento com um Modelo de Negócio Inovador: Você acredita em um modelo onde o cliente só paga pelo sucesso, sem custos de entrada ou taxas de manutenção? Nosso modelo de remuneração 100% no êxito é um dos nossos maiores diferenciais. Buscamos parceiros que saibam comunicar o poder de uma proposta de valor de risco zero. 3) Mentalidade\ "TaxTech\" Você vê a tecnologia como o futuro da gestão fiscal? Com nossa plataforma proprietária Athena™, analisamos 100% dos dados fiscais sem amostragem, garantindo precisão e escala incomparáveis. Buscamos parceiros que queiram liderar a transformação digital no setor tributário. O que Oferecemos à sua Parceria: - Portfólio de Alto Valor: Adicione as soluções AG, AG Tax e Agnes ao seu portfólio e resolva dores latentes de seus clientes.
- Modelo de Receita Atrativo: Gere uma nova e robusta linha de receita, 100% comissionada sobre o sucesso das operações, sem limite de ganhos.
- Força da Marca Líder: Associe-se à marca que é referência no mercado, com metodologia validada, operação segurada pela Berkley e reconhecimento pela mídia e por grandes premiações (Exame, Deloitte, BTG Pactual).
- Diferencial Competitivo: Ofereça aos seus clientes uma solução inovadora que a concorrência não possui, fortalecendo seu próprio posicionamento como consultor estratégico. Você se identifica com este perfil? Se você é um profissional visionário, com uma carteira de clientes consolidada e o desejo de gerar um impacto financeiro real para seus clientes e para o seu negócio, queremos conversar com você. Clique no link para saber mais e iniciar sua jornada como Parceiro Estratégico do Grupo AG Capital. #AGCapital #ParceriaEstrategica #TaxTech #ConsultoriaTributaria #Consultoria #AdvocaciaEmpresarial #RecuperacaoTributaria #InovacaoFiscal #Finanças #Contabilidade #eSocial #LucroReal#Vendas

title: Senior.Net Engineer
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Senior.Net Engineer em camaçari. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar. Senior .Net EngineerResume:English Version only. Resume should have detailed discussion of project overview and job description. Highlight the following if applicable - Maui (Blazor, Razor, Xamarin);
Healthcare projects;
HIPAA knowledge;
SAAS projects;
US-based projects Role:Full time contractor;
Fully Remote Work Hours: US time zone Location:Brazil Rate:R$20,000-22,000 per monthAbout the Company We are a forward-thinking technology organization dedicated to developing innovative software solutions that improve outcomes for clients and end-users. Our engineering team designs, builds, and maintains scalable, high-quality applications that drive efficiency and innovation across industries. We are seeking an experiencedLevel III Software Engineer (contractor)to join our distributed team, contributing to complex projects with a focus on code quality, security, and collaboration.Position Overview As a Level III Software Engineer (contractor), you will apply your technical expertise to deliver high-quality code for moderately to highly complex projects. Working remotely with a U.S.-based team, you'll gain deep system knowledge and contribute to an Agile development workflow using Azure DevOps. You will begin with automated testing and peer reviews, expanding into broader development tasks by months 2–3. The role will continue to evolve based on your strengths and project needs, while maintaining rigorous adherence to coding and security standards.Key Responsibilities Product Design & Development:Collaborate with stakeholders to design and implement software solutions aligned with technical and business objectives. Code Contributions:Write, optimize, and maintain efficient code, including enhancement of existing codebases, beginning around months 3–4. Testing & Quality:Design and implement automated end-to-end (E2E) tests (e.G., using Microsoft Playwright) to ensure feature stability—especially during the first 6–9 months. Peer Reviews:Participate in pre-release feature reviews and early post-release bug analysis (first 90 days), transitioning to broader ownership over time. Agile Workflow Participation:Actively contribute to sprints, pull requests, and releases within a 2-week sprint / 6-week release cycle using Azure DevOps. Collaboration:Communicate effectively with both technical and non-technical team members across multiple time zones.QualificationsExperience 5–8 years of software engineering experience with a demonstrated record of success on complex projects.Technical Skills Proficiency inC# ASP.NET (.NET 8)for web applications and APIs. Experience with.NET MAUIandBlazor Web Applications (.NET 8), leveraging web expertise for cross-platform or mobile development. Familiarity withMicrosoft Azureservices, including Azure App Service, Azure SQL, and Azure Storage. Strong understanding of modern development tools (e.G., Visual Studio, Git, Azure DevOps). Knowledge ofsecure coding practicesand general cybersecurity principles. Experience withcloud platformsandAgile methodologies .Soft Skills Excellent problem-solving and analytical abilities. Strong written and verbal communication skills for remote collaboration. Ability to work independently and within a collaborative team environment.Preferred Experience with regulated or data-sensitive software environments (e.G., healthcare, financial services, HIPAA, PHI). Prior experience conducting pull-request reviews and participating in Agile sprints.What We Offer Opportunity to work on impactful, large-scale technology projects. Collaborative, high-performance engineering culture focused on quality and innovation. Flexible remote work environment with a structured onboarding process for success.How We Work Agile Workflow:Two-week sprints within a six-week release cycle, including daily stand-ups (3:00 PM CT), sprint planning, and reviews. Code Standards:Strict adherence to best practices, peer reviews, and security testing (e.G., OWASP, Detectify). Tool Stack:Azure DevOps, Visual Studio, SQL Server Management Studio, Datadog, Microsoft Playwright, and related technologies. Team Culture:A focus on accountability, collaboration, and excellence in delivery.

title: Analista De Suporte N1
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Analista De Suporte N1 em camaçari. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

Venha integrar um time de excelência, somos a Eyemobile uma startup que nasceu para revolucionar o varejo!

Nossa missão é simplificar a forma como negócios vendem através de inovação e tecnologia.

Estamos há 12 anos no mercado, e em nossa história, temos muitos aprendizados e conquistas, que nos ajudaram a construir uma cultura sólida, com base em três pilares: o Cuidar, Imaginar e Simplificar. Tudo isso pensando em nossos clientes, parceiros, colaboradores e na tecnologia.

Se você se identifica com valores como: Simplicidade, Agilidade, Confiança, Inovação e Experiência do Cliente, já está há um passo à frente! Então, continue lendo para conhecer mais sobre essa oportunidade que pode mudar sua carreira!

Como Analista de Suporte N1, seu principal desafio será apoiar a jornada do cliente, orientando quanto a dúvidas e buscando soluções para possíveis problemas, garantindo sucesso na utilização da ferramenta.

No seu dia a dia estas serão suas responsabilidades:

  • Atuar com atendimento reativo multicanal (via ticket, chat online, email e ligação fonada) através do Movidesk e Canal Telecom;
  • Atuar com a análise de incidentes, dúvidas e novas solicitações para proporcionarmos a melhor experiência em nossa central de atendimento;
  • Realizar análise e alterações relacionadas às ações financeiras, como segunda via, alteração de data de vencimento, validação de inadimplência via plataforma;
  • Realizar reportpara o time N2 de incidentes ou problemas relacionados à plataforma bem como questões financeiras;
  • Identificar problemas e tendências nos atendimento aos parceiros, com o intuito de melhorar a eficiência e eficácia dos atendimentos;
  • Realizar pesquisa de documentação técnica da aplicação para entendimento do ambiente e parametrização;
  • Respeitar SLA definido para cada processo;
  • Garantir a altasatisfação do cliente sendo medido por métricas de avaliação de Tickets (CSAT).

Para desempenhar estas atividades entendemos que você precisa ter:

  • Experiência em atendimento ao cliente, orientado ao cliente no centro, para proporcionar a melhor experiência com a nossa plataforma;
  • Conhecimento básico em MySQL para realização de consultas simples;
  • Experiência comdiagnóstico e resolução de problemas sistêmicos;
  • Vivência com ferramentas de atendimento ao cliente, como chat, telefone, e-mail e aplicativos de mensagens;
  • Familiaridade com ferramentas como Insomnia/Postman para testes de API;
  • Excelentes habilidades de comunicação verbal e escrita, com a capacidade de lidar de forma empática e cuidadosa com clientes;
  • Escuta ativa e comunicação não violenta;
  • Compromisso coma eficiência operacional e satisfação do cliente;
  • Capacidade de trabalhar sob pressão e resolver problemas de forma eficaz e rápida, senso de urgência e mediação de conflitos;
  • Proatividade naidentificação e solução de problemas;
  • Habilidade de trabalhar de forma colaborativa em equipe.

Mais informações:

  • Modelo de contratação como Prestador de Serviço (PJ) - necessário ter CNPJ ativo
  • Nosso time de suporte atua em vários horários diferentes, ter disponibilidade de horários é importante para nós, confira abaixo como funciona:

Nossos horários e turnos durante a semana:

Segunda à sexta: 09:00 às 22:00

T1) 09:00 às 18:00

T2) 11:00 às 20:00

T3) 14:00 às 22:00

** Horários desta vaga à definir, mas nossa prioridade é para o 2o ou 3o turno.

Nossos horários finais de semana e feriados:

Sábados: 09:00 às 22:00 (2 pessoas de plantão com horários alternados)

Domingos: 10:00 às 20:00 (2 pessoas de plantão ambos trabalham 6 horas)

**Disponibilidade para realização de plantões aos finais de Semana e Feriados (pagamos valor adicional para os plantões, e quem inicia no time, só entra nas escalas de plantão após finalizar Onboarding / Rampagem).

Acha que é essa vaga é pra você? Não perca tempo e venha fazer parte da revolução do varejo com a gente! #vemsereyemaker!

Na Eye, temos o compromisso com a promoção de um ambiente mais igualitário, diverso e inclusivo, estimulando o respeito e a valorização das diferenças. Por isso, todas as pessoas candidatas qualificadas serão consideradas no processo seletivo, independentemente de raça, gênero, orientação sexual, religião, naturalidade, nacionalidade, deficiência, idade ou outras características.

title: Sr. O&G Supply Chain Analyst (Remote)
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Sr. O&G Supply Chain Analyst (Remote) em feira de santana. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

Location: Brazil (100% Remote)

Experience Level: Mid to Senior (3+ years)

Industry: Oil & Gas (Unconventional Upstream)

Role Summary

The Sr. Supply Chain Analyst – Drilling & Completions is responsible for supporting upstream U.S. land drilling and completions operations across multiple major U.S. basins. This role focuses on supply chain coordination, vendor management, operational reconciliation, and cost control across a variety of drilling and completions-related categories including frac sand, produced water, drill cuttings, transportation, disposal services, and other field operations support.

The ideal candidate is highly organized, analytical, and experienced working in fast-paced oilfield operations environments while coordinating across internal teams, vendors, and service providers.

Responsibilities

  • Coordinate daily supply chain and logistics activities supporting drilling and completions operations
  • Manage communication and execution across suppliers, trucking providers, disposal facilities, transloads, and field operations
  • Monitor operational demand and adjust logistics plans to prevent supply disruptions, delays, or operational downtime
  • Reconcile field tickets, service volumes, pricing, and vendor invoices against operational and financial systems
  • Investigate and resolve discrepancies related to deliveries, billing, operational reporting, and vendor performance
  • Support cost control initiatives by optimizing logistics efficiency and reducing standby and demurrage exposure
  • Collaborate with operations, engineering, procurement, accounting, and field teams to maintain accurate data and support daily operations

Requirements

  • Bachelor's degree
  • 3+ years of experience supporting upstream drilling and completions operations, oilfield logistics, or supply chain activities with U.S.-based oil & gas companies
  • Experience supporting categories such as frac sand, produced water, drill cuttings, transportation, or related oilfield services for U.S.-based operations
  • Experience with multiple major U.S. basins preferred
  • Experience with SAP or similar ERP systems required
  • Experience working with vendor invoice and operational systems such as OpenInvoice, WellView, OpenWells, or similar platforms
  • Strong analytical, problem-solving, and organizational skills
  • Ability to manage multiple priorities in a fast-paced operational environment
  • Strong communication and coordination skills across internal and external stakeholders

Technical Requirements

  • SAP or similar ERP systems
  • OpenInvoice, WellView, OpenWells or comparable
  • Microsoft Excel including pivot tables, reconciliations, and large dataset analysis
  • Experience working with operational, logistics, and financial reporting data for U.S.-based oil & gas operations

We do all of our video editing (except for color grading and sound) in After Effects, so we’re looking for a video editor who is skilled with the software. Your role will be handling all the video editing for one of our well-established clients. Your job will include everything necessary to make professional YouTube videos, such as:

  • Color grading
  • Trimming
  • Audio post production
  • Planning the appropriate visuals for each video
  • Finding footage and imagery that match our clients’ branding
  • Using AI effectively to generate custom visuals
  • Laying out media
  • Importing and using motion graphic templates
  • Creating custom animations
  • Creating AI avatars (we'll show you how)
  • Finding and editing appropriate music
  • Finding and editing appropriate sound effects
  • Strategic editing (understanding what to cut, what to include, and how to structure it for maximum engagement)


Here is a reel of our work to give you an idea of the type of video editing we do:


Our Values:

It's important that you are in alignment with our values. If this doesn't sound like you, do NOT apply:


  • Quality First - We are a PREMIUM agency, so it's important that you're driven to constantly do your best work and take your skills to the next level. If you're just looking for a job that is easy to do and doesn't require you to think carefully about your editing, this role is NOT for you.


  • High Accountability - You want to take responsibility for your successes AND your failures. If we call you out for doing poor-quality work or delivering late, you have the emotional maturity to take ownership for it and use that to drive you to do better next time.


  • Directness - We don't beat around the bush. If you do great work, we praise you and let you know. Similarly, if something is bad, we tell you it's bad. If you can't take direct criticism, this role is NOT for you.


  • Independence - You are good at solving your own problems. We are here to help, and will go out of our way to train you and make you feel comfortable in your role, but you should be eager to own this position and do it well without us needing to constantly push you.


Additional Requirements:

Below is a list of additional requirements for the job, please read through it carefully before applying:

  • Advanced English proficiency
  • Available the equivalent of full-time (at least 40 hours per week)
  • Willing to work on weekends when necessary
  • Available to start within the next two weeks
  • Advanced After Effects skills: 3D, Rotoscoping, Masking, Motion tracking, Keying, Expressions
  • Have a “design eye”: the ability to create and follow aesthetic branding guidelines
  • Professional, meaning you deliver professional-grade work on time
  • Highly responsive


The Offer:

If hired, we will provide free copies of all the plugins we use ($500 in tools), pay for your Magnific (formerly Freepik) and Envato accounts, and teach you how to edit videos in After Effects the same way we do.


Your starting pay will be $1,500-$2,500USD per month depending on your skill level. Once you show us that you can complete the work without needing much feedback, we will increase your monthly base by $500USD. You can also earn a performance bonus of $500USD every month. So you have potential to be making as much as $3,500USD/mo within months of starting (if you're good).

title: Lab Systems Architect
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Lab Systems Architect em salvador. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

ABOUT US

Syniti, part of Capgemini is the enterprise data partner, empowering anyone who relies on data to make business-critical decisions by delivering data they can trust through a unique combination of intelligent software and experts who deeply understand the role of data in enterprise growth. At Syniti, we tackle the hardest work in data for the world’s largest organizations. As the industry’s only pure-play data company, we combine our Data First strategy, intelligent software and team of 100% data-focused experts to turn complex data initiatives into quantifiable business success.



Trusted by the Fortune 2000, Syniti helps leading businesses reconfigure the role of enterprise data from afterthought to foundational first step;
enabling them to unlockvaluable insights that ignite growth, reduce risk, and expand their competitive advantage. We’ve enabled more than 5,000 successful projects and we’re a trusted partner for global enterprises and organizations throughout their data journeys.



Syniti’s Data First philosophy and enterprise data management platform supports data migration, data quality, data replication, data matching, master data management, analytics, data governance, and data strategy in a single, unified solution.



THE ROLE

The Lab Systems Architect plays a critical role in the success of Syniti’s Education Services department by designing, implementing, and maintaining technical lab environments that support both eLearning and instructor-led training. This role ensures the seamless operation of lab systems, supports integration with learning platforms, and collaborates cross-functionally to enhance system workflows and user experience. The ideal candidate is a technically skilled, detail-oriented problem solver with a passion for enabling learning through robust infrastructure.



WHAT YOU WILL DO

Learning Lab Architecture & Management

  • Provide technical oversight for the design, testing, provisioning, and implementation of Learning Lab environments.
  • Manage and maintain lab snapshots, resolving configuration defects as they arise.
  • Optimize lab usage policies in collaboration with Education Coordinators and Leadership.
  • Monitor VM usage reports and metrics, ensuring alignment with budget and demand.
  • Support LMS system integrations as required.
  • Serve as the primary escalation point for lab-related issues and liaise with solution providers to resolve complex problems across all learning lab platforms.


System Administration & Support

  • Allocate and reset user training accounts.
  • Stay current with new feature releases across all education platforms.
  • Provide on-call support for lab systems used in global training programs, including availability during evenings and weekends as needed.
  • Regularly review help desk tickets to identify recurring issues, usage patterns, and knowledge gaps. Recommend targeted training, updated documentation, or additional support resources to proactively address common challenges and improve user experience.
  • Train internal and partner instructors on lab systems.


Cross-Functional Collaboration & Stakeholder Management

  • Collaborate with Training Operations, Delivery Management, IT, and Application teams to improve workflows, system functionality, and user experience.
  • Manage stakeholder expectations and requirements related to lab systems and processes.
  • Identify and resolve cross-functional issues to ensure company-wide alignment on lab system needs.


Reporting & Documentation

  • Document system configurations, best practices, and technical procedures.
  • Own and maintain the Education Services Revenue Report, providing monthly updates to Finance.
  • Support the creation and maintenance of Education Services forms, lists, automations, and integrations, as required.



WHAT IT TAKES

  • Proficiency in SQL and at least one of the following databases: Oracle, MS SQL Server, IBM DB2, or MySQL.
  • Experience managing hypervisor solutions and SaaS platform architecture.
  • Knowledge of Microsoft Forms, Power Automate, Power BI, and SharePoint.
  • Experience with Windows Server and Azure Active Directory.
  • Understanding of the Software Development Life Cycle (SDLC).
  • Strong technical writing and documentation skills.
  • Excellent communication, collaboration, and stakeholder management abilities.
  • Knowledge of GraphQL queries and mutations (preferred).
  • Self-starter with a proactive approach to problem-solving.
  • Ability to manage multiple priorities in a fast-paced environment.
  • Passion for education technology and continuous improvement.



Be fully aligned to our core values:


  • Think Big - Be courageous and bold. Aspire to greatness. Relentlessly pursue market innovation. Set the standard by which others follow. Create solutions that have a meaningful impact. Solve the challenges our customers don’t know they have.
  • Be Curious - Be a lifelong learner. Seek out new ideas to serve customers. Understand our competition and the world. Be permanently dissatisfied with the status quo. Challenge preconceptions. Focus on the future rather than yesterday.
  • Take Action - Be the first. Don’t wait. Take accountability. Inspire others by doing. Fail fast and learn from mistakes. Make a difference every day.
  • Stronger Together - Respect, trust and look out for each other. Celebrate diverse perspectives. Listen. Build connections and belonging. Act with integrity. Give back. One Syniti family.



WHAT WE OFFER

  • Trust in your talent. At Syniti you will find a supportive environment and access to learning tools, but micromanagement is not our style.
  • Growth . We are growing rapidly and steadily solving the biggest challenges enterprise companies are faced with today. There was never a better time to join and grow with us. Most importantly you will have the chance to shape our journey and share in our success story.
  • Support . We all rely on each other and enable each other to be successful. You won’t stand alone.
  • Curiosity and genuine interest in you . We all have our different stories, all equally fascinating with each depicting a different journey and we want to hear them all.
  • Recognition . We are the sum of individual achievements and we always take the time to celebrate them.
  • An open organisation . Titles don’t define access at Syniti. We stay humble regardless of where we sit in the organisation. We want to hear every voice, listen to all the ideas and make sure everyone’s work is seen and valued.



Our Commitment to Inclusion


At Syniti, we’re committed to creating a respectful, inclusive, and fair workplace where everyone belongs and thrives. We believe that diverse perspectives make us stronger — and we value the unique backgrounds, experiences, and voices each person brings to our team.

We welcome applicants based on their skills and potential, and we’re dedicated to ensuring equal opportunities for all, regardless of personal background. If you need accommodations during the hiring process, please let us know — we’re here to support you.

  • Experiência comserviços de nuvem como Firebase, AWS, GCloud ou similares;
  • Familiaridade com bancos de dados relacionais e não relacionais, como Postgres e MongoDB;
  • Experiência comtestes automatizados e práticas de qualidade de software;
  • Conhecimento emarquitetura de software, APIs, padrões de desenvolvimento e boas práticas (Clean Code/Clean Architecture);
  • Experiência compráticas de DevOps, automação e pipelines CI/CD;
  • Vivência com arquitetura orientada a serviços e/ou ambientes serverless;
  • Experiência comGit e metodologias ágeis (Scrum/Kanban);

  • Capacidade de resolver problemas complexos e construir soluções escaláveis.


Diferenciais:

  • Vivência em construção, evolução e definição de arquitetura técnica;
  • Experiência ou potencial para atuar como referência técnica ou evoluir para uma posição de Tech Lead, apoiando decisões técnicas, mentoria e desenvolvimento do time;
  • Experiência comtecnologias de desenvolvimento mobile ou híbrido, como React Native, Capacitor, Cordova ou Ionic;
  • Experiência em ambientes de startup e crescimento acelerado.


O que você pode esperar dos Supers?

  • Uma cultura de muita confiança, colaboração, focada em resultados, com muita autonomia e transparência;
  • Buscamos excelência em tudo o que fazemos, por isso estamos sempre aprendendo;
  • Temos vontade de construir junto, fazer a diferença e gerar impacto.


O que oferecemos:

title: Office Coordinator
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Office Coordinator em salvador. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

Studio58 is seeking a highly organized, proactive, and detail-oriented Office Coordinator to support the daily operations of our commercial architecture office.


This role is ideal for someone who thrives in a fast-paced environment and is capable of managing administrative operations, client communication, permitting coordination, documentation management, and vendor communication across multiple active projects.


The ideal candidate must be organized, resourceful, professional, and able to keep projects and communication flowing efficiently throughout all phases of the project lifecycle.


⸻


CORE RESPONSIBILITIES


Administrative & Office Operations

* Maintain organization of all company and project documentation

* Create, organize, and maintain digital project folders

* Manage internal administrative workflows and operational processes

* Support leadership team with administrative and operational tasks

* Coordinate calendars, meetings, appointments, and follow-ups

* Prepare and organize contracts, proposals, forms, submittals, and project documents

* Maintain organized records of permits, inspections, approvals, COs, invoices, and project documentation

* Assist with internal reporting, spreadsheets, trackers, and operational organization

* Coordinate signatures and collection of required project documentation

* Handle office correspondence, emails, phone calls, and administrative communication

* Help maintain office systems, templates, and document standards

* Take meeting notes and organize action items and follow-ups


Client Communication & Coordination

* Serve as one of the primary points of contact for clients throughout the project lifecycle

* Coordinate onboarding of new clients and project startup processes

* Ensure clients receive timely communication, updates, and responses

* Follow up with clients regarding pending approvals, documents, payments, selections, and project requirements

* Assist with post-sale and post-project communication

* Help manage client expectations and internal communication flow

* Coordinate scheduling between clients, consultants, contractors, and internal team members

* Escalate issues, delays, or missing information proactively to management


Permitting & Expediting Coordination

* Prepare and upload permit applications and documentation to city and county portals

* Coordinate permitting submissions, revisions, resubmittals, and corrections

* Maintain communication with municipalities, permitting departments, plan reviewers, and inspectors

* Track permit status, comments, approvals, revisions, inspections, and expiration dates

* Coordinate collection of required documentation from engineers, consultants, contractors, and vendors

* Organize and maintain permit logs, approval records, inspection records, and compliance documentation

* Assist with permit close-outs and Certificate of Occupancy documentation

* Schedule inspections and coordinate inspection-related documentation

* Follow up proactively with cities and jurisdictions to help keep projects moving efficiently

* Assist with research of permitting requirements, zoning information, and jurisdictional processes

* Help identify missing information or documentation prior to submissions

* Maintain awareness of permitting deadlines and compliance requirements

* Help maintain organized vendor and consultant databases


⸻


REQUIRED QUALIFICATIONS


* Fluent English required — professional written and verbal communication is mandatory

* Portuguese preferred but not required

* Strong organizational and multitasking skills

* Excellent verbal and written communication skills

* Ability to work independently and proactively

* Strong attention to detail and follow-through

* Comfortable working in a fast-paced environment with multiple active projects

* Professional demeanor and client-facing communication skills

* No experience required


⸻


ADDITIONAL REQUIREMENTS


* Reliable computer and connection to the internet required


⸻


ABOUT STUDIO58


Studio58 is a commercial architecture and construction firm focused on creating strategic spaces that help businesses grow. Our work combines design, branding, permitting, and construction coordination to create environments that are both functional and impactful.

  • Excellent communication skills in English (written and verbal)
  • Problem-solving mindset with focus on risk reduction and process improvement

title: Integration Engineer
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Integration Engineer em salvador. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

About the Product

Anterior is on a mission to transform healthcare administration, making it seamless and invisible so clinicians can focus on delivering care. We’ve built an AI-powered platform designed by clinicians, for clinicians, to simplify administrative workflows and improve patient outcomes. By combining clinical expertise with cutting-edge technology, we’re revolutionizing healthcare operations with responsible AI.

We’re growing rapidly and are backed by world-class investors including Sequoia, New Enterprise Associates NEA, and Neo along with notable angels including the founders of DeepMind, Google AI, and Inflection AI.

Anterior is improving the experience of healthcare for everyone. We’re working on the cutting edge of using technology to make clinical decision-making frictionless.We’re building exciting tech for huge customers and we trust in the foundations: keep it simple, build strong foundations, and the rest will follow.


The Team

At Anterior, engineers share a strong “sense of product” and solve meaningful problems that simplify healthcare workflows. We collaborate in multidisciplinary teams to deliver secure, scalable, and user-focused solutions guided by best practices and modular design.

We’re building a dedicated deployments team focused on deploying our platform into large US enterprise healthcare environments. This team works closely with customers and our core platform engineers to ensure seamless, reliable integrations into complex payer systems of record.


About You

You have a passion for doing things The Right Way, you believe Less is More, you want to focus on the foundations of system design and architecture (pacelc, consistency guarantees), you care as much about the code you do not write, you’re tired of the hype treadmill and care about the fundamentals. You have battle scars from over-engineered and underperforming slop, and you care about writing code that lasts.

Your depth is in building integrations, APIs, and data pipelines that connect complex systems together reliably. You’ve worked with enterprise customers, dealt with messy data, conflicting sources of truth, and deduplication challenges.

You’ve owned integration design decisions end-to-end — from scoping requirements with a customer to shipping it to production and making sure it holds up. You may be coming from a health tech company, a scale-up doing enterprise deployments, or a platform team that built the connective tissue between systems — what matters is that you’ve navigated real integration complexity and you want ownership over what you build.


About the Role

Members of Technical Staff (Deployments) at Anterior own customer deployment problems end-to-end — from scoping integrations through to production. You’ll be the bridge between our AI platform and the enterprise healthcare systems it plugs into.

A day’s work may include:

  • Designing and building integrations, APIs, and data pipelines that connect our platform to customer systems of record EHRs, claims platforms, care management systems)
  • Working directly with US enterprise healthcare customers to understand their architecture, scope integration requirements, and translate them into technical specs
  • Building and maintaining FHIR, HL7, and custom API integrations with payer and health plan systems
  • Debugging data quality issues — conflicting sources of truth, deduplication, schema mismatches, and edge cases specific to healthcare data
  • Owning UAT testing end-to-end, working with customer IT teams to validate data flows before go-live
  • Building internal tooling and shared integration patterns that make the next deployment faster
  • Contributing to Anterior’s SDKs, developer documentation, and integration playbooks
  • Collaborating closely with the core platform team in New York to ensure integration needs inform platform architecture


Tech

  • Langs: Python / TS
  • Infra: Nix, AWS
  • Healthcare data: FHIR, HL7 (experience preferred but not required — you’ll learn fast if you have strong API and data pipeline fundamentals)


What we’re looking for

  • Strong backend engineering fundamentals — APIs, data pipelines, distributed systems
  • Experience integrating with enterprise systems, ideally in healthcare (payer, EHR, claims) but complex enterprise integrations in other industries count too
  • Comfort working directly with customers and translating ambiguous requirements into clean technical solutions
  • Experience with data quality challenges — deduplication, schema mapping, reconciliation across multiple sources of truth
  • Strong written and spoken communication in English — you’ll be collaborating with teams and customers across time zones
  • Ability to work autonomously from detailed technical specs while flagging blockers and ambiguity early
  • Timezone compatibility with US East Coast ET) working hours


What’s in it for you

This is an opportunity to join a company at its major inflection point, using cutting- edge technology to have a meaningful impact in healthcare. You’ll work with a world-class team, hold significant responsibility, and have the opportunity to learn and grow rapidly.


We offer

  • We welcome new ideas and allow you to make an immediate impact on the team.
  • Flexible Paid time off (PTO for any reason, including sick days (no specified limits) and flexible work schedule).
  • Personal laptop.
  • Health and wellness package.
  • Fully remote.


As this is an English-speaking role, we kindly ask that all applications be submitted with a CV in English.

title: Data Engineering Coordinator (Remoto)
description:

Buscamos um(a) profissional com perfil player-coach , capaz de equilibrar uma atuação técnica hands-on com a liderança de equipe, sendo responsável por guiar o time na construção de uma infraestrutura de dados moderna, escalável e orientada ao negócio. É essencial possuir inglês avançado ou fluente para conversação , já que a posição envolve interação constante com times e stakeholders internacionais. A contratação é no modelo CLT , com atuação 100% remota .


Principais Responsabilidades:


Atuação Estratégica e Técnica

  • Atuar como engenheiro(a) sênior, participando diretamente do desenvolvimento (design, codificação e entrega de features).
  • Liderar o desenho e evolução da arquitetura de dados, garantindo escalabilidade, confiabilidade e performance.
  • Trabalhar com tecnologias modernas como Snowflake, Databricks e serviços em cloud (AWS/Azure).
  • Gerenciar e desenvolver o time, promovendo um ambiente colaborativo e de alta performance.
  • Incentivar o crescimento técnico e de carreira dos engenheiros.
  • Atuar em conjunto com Product Managers na descoberta e definição de soluções, garantindo alinhamento com necessidades do negócio.
  • Definir e garantir boas práticas de arquitetura, engenharia e metodologias ágeis.
  • Gerenciar e reduzir dívida técnica da plataforma.
  • Liderar iniciativas de análise, planejamento e execução de projetos de dados.
  • Garantir entregas consistentes e alinhadas com os objetivos estratégicos.


Responsabilidades do Dia a Dia:

  • Desenvolver e otimizar pipelines de dados e processos de ETL (Airbyte, Fivetran, Azure Data Factory).
  • Construir e manter infraestrutura de dados robusta e escalável.
  • Trabalhar de forma colaborativa com times de dados, produto, engenharia e stakeholders de negócio.
  • Gerenciar infraestrutura com práticas modernas (Terraform, Ansible, Azure Application Insights).
  • Garantir governança, qualidade e confiabilidade dos dados.
  • Atuar na operação de ambientes produtivos, incluindo suporte a incidentes críticos.
  • Promover inovação contínua e adoção de novas tecnologias, incluindo uso de IA no ciclo de desenvolvimento.


Requisitos Técnicos (Obrigatórios)

  • Experiência sólida com pipelines de dados, ETL e ambientes produtivos.
  • Experiência com Airbyte, Fivetran, Snowflake, Databricks e Azure Data Factory.
  • Forte domínio de SQL e modelagem de dados (incluindo grandes volumes).
  • Experiência com ferramentas de BI como Power BI e Sigma.
  • Conhecimento em Infraestrutura como Código (Terraform, Ansible).
  • Programação em Python (diferencial: Scala).
  • Experiência com Docker e Kubernetes.
  • Conhecimento em data lakes, bancos relacionais, NoSQL e OLAP.
  • Boa comunicação e visão orientada a produto.
  • Inglês fluente.


Diferenciais

  • Experiência com pipelines de AI/ML e serviços como AWS SageMaker ou Azure Synapse.
  • Vivência com governança de dados e qualidade.
  • Background em sistemas distribuídos, APIs ou arquiteturas orientadas a eventos.


Formação e Experiência

  • Mais de 6 anos de experiência em Data Engineering (hands-on).
  • Mais de 3 anos liderando times ou iniciativas de dados.
  • Formação em Ciência da Computação, Data Science ou áreas correlatas.

title: Business Operations Sr Analyst
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Business Operations Sr Analyst em salvador. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

What is Teachable?

Teachable is trusted by creator-educators around the world to grow their impact and income. From online courses and communities to memberships and downloads, Teachable's digital learning products help creator-educators drive meaningful connection and sustainable revenue. With industry-best ecommerce tools, easily toggled on directly within the platform, creators can confidently maximize their earnings, while getting paid directly by their audience. Teachable's unmatched focus on the student learning experience also ensures creators can make a positive and influential impact on their communities—entirely on their own terms. Today, tens of thousands of creator-educators use Teachable to share their knowledge, reaching millions of students around the world. To learn more, visit teachable.Com.


Are you ready to join a dynamic, cross-cultural team at an exciting turning point in our company’s journey? Now part of the global Hotmart Company portfolio, whose platforms have helped creators earn more than $10 billion, Teachable continues to take the creator economy by storm as a true industry leader. Together, Teachable and Hotmart are delivering market-leading products that prioritize creator control and flexibility, alongside meaningful partnership and support from our team. If you have big ideas, relish the chance to challenge convention, and deeply believe in the power of creators to shape the future, we want you on our team!


Your Mission

We are seeking a highly analytical and strategic Customer Success Operations Sr Analyst to strengthen our Customer Success strategy and accelerate our go-to-market engine in a rapidly growing SaaS company. You will partner with CS, Finance, Product, Marketing, and Data teams to design scalable processes, implement effective incentives and structures, and ensure execution aligns with business priorities. This is a high-impact role with strong visibility and influence across the organization.


Key Responsibilities:

  • Partner with CS and executive leadership to define the go-to-market strategy—including segmentation, sales motions, and revenue growth priorities.
  • Design and continuously refine quota-setting frameworks, territory models, and headcount planning to enable scalable growth.
  • Develop compensation strategies and incentive structures that drive exceptional performance while aligning with company objectives.
  • Build and manage strategic dashboards and frameworks to monitor CS productivity, NRR, Excel/Google Sheets as needed.
  • Translate business questions into analytical projects, delivering actionable insights to guide product focus, market entry, and commercial efficiency.
  • Drive operational rigor through annual/quarterly planning cycles, cross-functional alignment, and performance reviews.
  • Identify and implement process improvements across tools, data flows, and CRM workflows (HubSpot) to enhance efficiency at scale.


Requirements:

  • 3–4 years of experience in Customer Success Operations or Business Operations, preferably within a SaaS or technology company.
  • Strong proficiency in Excel/Sheets and CRM tools (HubSpot knowledge is a plus)
  • Solid understanding of SaaS metrics and revenue motions (new business, upsell, retention).
  • Excellent communication skills in English (both written and verbal).
  • Proven ability to collaborate cross-functionally and independently lead complex initiatives.
  • Comfortable presenting insights and recommendations to senior leadership.
  • Bachelor’s degree in Engineering, Economics, Business, or a related field.
  • Advanced spoken and written English skills.


Why Join Us?

  • Opportunity to work in a high-growth SaaS environment with global exposure.
  • Direct impact on go-to-market strategy and revenue growth.
  • Collaborative, data-driven, and entrepreneurial culture.
  • Competitive compensation and benefits package.
  • This is a role based in Brazil, and you’ll collaborate closely with teams across the U.S. and Brazil.


Your work will follow Brasilia Standard Time (BRT), and you’ll be hired as a CLT contract employee with compensation in BRL.

A Studio Rx é uma empresa de produção global digital, criada para as necessidades exclusivas das marcas de saúde. Como Hub de produção da IPG Health, o Studio RX apoia a rede global de agências do grupo, tendo como pilares principais a qualidade e eficiência.

  • Ser responsávelpela revisão final e controle de qualidade das apresentações antes do compartilhamento, assegurando clareza, consistência visual e precisão das informações;
  • Trabalhar de forma independente ou colaborativa com outros designers, gerenciando múltiplos projetos simultaneamente e mantendo alta performance em ambientes de ritmo acelerado.


Requerimentos & Skills:

  • Experiência mínima de 4 anos em Design de Apresentações, com formação superior (bacharelado) em Design, Artes Visuais ou áreas correlatas;
  • Domínio avançado de ferramentas de apresentação, incluindo PowerPoint, Google Slides, Keynote e Prezi, além de proficiência em ferramentas essenciais do dia a dia, como Word e Excel, para organização, edição e estruturação de conteúdos e dados
  • Possuir conhecimento sólido em Design da Informação e Visualização de Dados, sendo capaz de transformar dados complexos em gráficos, dashboards, mapas e infográficos claros, estratégicos e visualmente atraentes. Espera-se domínio de hierarquia visual, organização da informação, escolha adequada de visualizações, simplificação de conteúdos densos e capacidade de comunicar insights de forma intuitiva para diferentes públicos.
  • Conhecimento em animação e construção de apresentações interativas, utilizando transições e motion design para criar narrativas visuais fluidas, dinâmicas e envolventes
  • Conhecimento em ferramentas de design e edição visual, como Adobe Creative Suite (Photoshop, Illustrator e InDesign) e/ou Figma, para criação e refinamento de assets gráficos, layouts e materiais de apoio
  • Conhecimento de ferramentas de inteligência artificial (IA) aplicadas à automação e otimização de processos criativos, como Microsoft Copilot, Gemini, Claude, Gamma, Adobe Firefly e recursos de IA integrados ao Photoshop
  • Forte repertório em design gráfico, com domínio de tipografia, teoria das cores, hierarquia visual, contraste, grids/alinhamentos e princípios de composição, além de olhar apurado para criar materiais limpos, sofisticados e profissionais;
  • Excelentes habilidades de comunicação, colaboração e gerenciamento de projetos, com capacidade para atuar em múltiplas demandas simultaneamente;

title: Data Scientist - Especialista
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Data Scientist - Especialista em salvador. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

No Grupo SBF, reunimos duas grandes forças do esporte no Brasil: a Centauro, maior varejista esportiva multimarcas da América Latina, e a Fisia, distribuidora oficial da Nike no país.


Queremos ser referência em esporte no Brasil e construir um futuro em que cada experiência com o esporte inspire, motive e transforme.


E aí, que tal vestir essa camisa com a gente?


Buscamos uma pessoa Cientista de Dados para atuar na frente de Alocação/Abastecimento em varejo, com foco em decisão de estoque orientada por dados (reduzir ruptura/excesso e aumentar venda/margem com nível de serviço).

Essa posição é estratégica para evoluirmos a alocação como produto: vai do diagnóstico e modelagem até deploy, monitoramento, IA aplicada à decisão e mensuração de impacto, atuando em parceria com Produto, Engenharia/MLE, Planning, Logística e Negócio.


Principais Responsabilidades

  • Liderar o desenvolvimento, evolução e operacionalização de modelos avançados de machine learning para problemas de negócio de alta complexidade.
  • Atuar em desafios de modelagem preditiva, incluindo previsão de demanda, identificação de padrões comportamentais, otimização e apoio à tomada de decisão.
  • Estruturar abordagens robustas de experimentação, validação e monitoramento de modelos, garantindo qualidade, confiabilidade e evolução contínua das soluções.
  • Construir pipelines analíticos escaláveis para preparação, transformação e exploração de grandes volumes de dados.
  • Trabalhar em parceria com times multidisciplinares para transformar problemas ambíguos em soluções analíticas aplicáveis e escaláveis.
  • Liderar discussões técnicas sobre arquitetura analítica, boas práticas de modelagem e evolução da disciplina de ciência de dados.
  • Explorar e desenvolver soluções baseadas em IA aplicada, incluindo agentes inteligentes, automação de processos analíticos e uso de modelos generativos quando fizer sentido para o problema.
  • Apoiar a operacionalização de soluções analíticas em produção, incluindo monitoramento, performance e governança.
  • Comunicar recomendações, aprendizados e trade-offs técnicos de forma clara para stakeholders técnicos e de negócio.
  • Atuar como referência técnica para o time, apoiando o desenvolvimento de outros cientistas por meio de mentorias, revisões técnicas e disseminação de conhecimento.


Requisitos Necessários

  • Experiência comprovada de 6 a 8 anos em projetos de ciência de dados.
  • Forte domínio de estatística, machine learning e experimentação.
  • Experiência sólida em modelagem preditiva aplicada a problemas complexos de negócio, incluindo previsão de demanda e séries temporais, com domínio de algoritmos de machine learning supervisionado como XGBoost, LightGBM e CatBoost.
  • Proficiência em Python e SQL para análise, modelagem e manipulação de grandes volumes de dados.
  • Experiência com ambientes cloud e ecossistemas analíticos escaláveis (BigQuery, Airflow ou similares).
  • Capacidade de transformar problemas de negócio pouco estruturados em soluções analíticas robustas.
  • Experiência com implantação, monitoramento e evolução de modelos em produção.
  • Forte capacidade analítica, pensamento crítico e excelente comunicação com stakeholders técnicos e não técnicos.
  • Noções de MLOps.
  • Sólida vivência em versionamento de código (Git), com prática de code review, padrões de branches e integração contínua.

Diferenciais

  • Experiência com IA generativa, LLMs e desenvolvimento de agentes.
  • Vivência com frameworks como LangChain, LangGraph, CrewAI ou similares.
  • Experiência em varejo.
  • Conhecimento em técnicas de visualização de dados e storytelling.
  • Familiaridade com ferramentas de business intelligence, como Power BI.

description:

title: Senior Data Analyst (Web Analytics)
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Senior Data Analyst (Web Analytics) em salvador. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

Senior Data Analyst (Web Analytics)

A jornada de quem ama repensar o futuro está aqui.

Sobre a Rethink

Somos uma consultoria que une tecnologia, design e estratégia de produtos digitais para solucionar os desafios de grandes empresas brasileiras. Agora como parte da Framework Digital , ampliamos nosso impacto atuando de ponta a ponta na jornada digital, da concepção à escala.

Nossa missão é gerar valor real por meio de soluções que conectam times, sistemas e pessoas. Acreditamos que a transformação digital acontece quando estratégia, tecnologia e experiência andam juntas e é isso que entregamos.

Empresas como Smiles, Gol, Santander Esfera, Swift e Comgás confiam em nossa parceria para acelerar sua evolução digital com consistência e resultado.


Diversidade e Inclusão

Para repensar o futuro, é essencial garantir ambientes mais diversos e inclusivos . Por isso, incentivamos fortemente a candidatura de mulheres, pessoas pretas, pardas, indígenas, LGBTQIAPN+ e pessoas com deficiência .

Que tal repensar um futuro mais diverso com a gente?


Qual será o seu papel?

Você será o principal responsável por transformar dados de comportamento digital em inteligência estratégica para o negócio. Atuará como referência técnica em mensuração e análise de performance web, garantindo que as decisões de produto, marketing e experiência do usuário sejam guiadas por dados confiáveis e bem interpretados. Seu trabalho conecta diretamente o que acontece nas propriedades digitais com os resultados que a empresa busca atingir.



Como será seu dia a dia?

  • Desenvolver e manter dashboards e relatórios de performance digital, acompanhando métricas como tráfego, conversão, engajamento e funis de aquisição
  • Implementar e auditar tags de rastreamento via Google Tag Manager, garantindo a integridade da coleta de dados nas propriedades digitais
  • Realizar análises exploratórias e apresentar insights para times de produto, marketing e liderança, traduzindo dados complexos em recomendações utilizáveis
  • Trabalhar em conjunto com os times de produto e UX para definir eventos de rastreamento, apoiar testes A/B e interpretar resultados de experimentos
  • Colaborar com times de engenharia e BI para estruturar pipelines de dados e garantir a disponibilidade das informações nas ferramentas certas
  • Disseminar a cultura de dados dentro da organização, apoiando outras áreas na utilização e interpretação de métricas digitais



Para esta vaga, é essencial:

  • Sólida experiência com Google Analytics 4 (GA4) e Google Tag Manager (GTM)
  • Conhecimento em configuração, implantação e estruturação de dataLayer via código (Javascript) ou Google Tag Manager (GTM)
  • Domínio de SQL para extração e análise de dados em ambientes de Data Warehouse (BigQuery, Amazon Redshift ou similar)
  • Experiência com ferramentas de visualização como Looker Studio, Quicksight, Power BI ou Tableau
  • Capacidade de comunicar análises e recomendações de forma clara para públicos não técnicos
  • Conhecimento em conceitos de mensuração digital: eventos, dimensões, métricas, atribuição e modelos de funil
  • Perfil analítico com autonomia para conduzir projetos de ponta a ponta com poucos direcionamentos
  • Experiência com ferramentas de Gestão de Projetos como JIRA e Confluence
  • Experiência com metodologias ágeis como Scrum ou Kanban
  • Capacidade de gerir e disseminar conhecimento técnico com analistas de menor senioridade.



Você pode se destacar se tiver:

  • Experiência com Python ou R para análises mais avançadas (segmentação, modelos preditivos, análise estatística)
  • Conhecer ferramentas de análise de comportamento como Hotjar, Clarity ou similares
  • Vivência com plataformas de CRM Analytics ou dados de mídia paga integrados ao contexto de web analytics (Insider One, Salesforce)
  • Processos de implementação ou migração de ferramentas de analytics (ex: UA → GA4)
  • Migração de dados entre Data Warehouses (Big Query → AWS)
  • Conceitos de privacidade de dados e suas implicações na coleta (LGPD, consentimento, server-side tracking)
  • Plataformas de cloud (AWS, GCP, Azure)



Curtiu a oportunidade?

Então, vem repensar o futuro com a gente! ✨

title: Engenheiro Ia
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Engenheiro Ia em salvador. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

Job Description

A Genesis Consulting tem oportunidade para Engenheiros de IA experientes com verdadeira paixão por crescimento profissional e entrega de valor através da tecnologia. Nossos clientes são alguns dos principais líderes mundiais em diferentes indústrias e o candidato fará parte de projetos desafiadores para construir e apoiar soluções técnicas para suas necessidades.


Duties and Responsibilities:

- Pesquisar, desenvolver e implementar metodologias avançadas de Large Language Models (LLMs) para criação de produtos de dados baseados em IA generativa.

- Desenvolver e aprimorar técnicas de Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG), combinando embeddings e bancos de vetores para melhorar precisão e relevância das respostas dos modelos.

- Aplicar técnicas de segurança e governança para IA generativa, mitigando alucinações, viés e riscos éticos no uso de LLMs.

- Automatizar e monitorar o desempenho de modelos generativos em produção, utilizando frameworks de MLOps e ferramentas de observabilidade de IA.

- Trabalhar em estreita colaboração com times de engenharia, produto e negócio para transformar desafios empresariais em soluções escaláveis baseadas em IA generativa.


Minimum Qualifications/Experience:

- Experiência comprovada no desenvolvimento e aplicação de LLMs e fluxos agênticos.

- Forte domínio de Python, frameworks como LangGraph, PydanticAI, LlamaIndex, e ferramentas de MLOps para produção de modelos generativos.

- Proficiência em Vector Databases (FAISS, ChromaDB, Weaviate, Milvus, Pinecone) e pipelines de dados escaláveis.

- Conhecimento avançado em Machine Learning, Deep Learning e Fine-Tuning de modelos fundacionais.

- Experiência com deploy e monitoramento de modelos em produção, incluindo técnicas de inferência eficiente, caching e otimização.

- Familiaridade com conceitos de governança, segurança e alinhamento de modelos generativos.


Minimum Education:

  • Ensino superior completo.
  • Inglês Fluente

title: Social Media Lead/Community Manager
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Social Media Lead/Community Manager em salvador. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

We’re hiring: Social Lead / Social Media & Community Manager

Earned Media Productions (EMP) is looking for someone who can turn podcasts into growth engines — and build engaged communities around them.

This role sits at the intersection of content distribution, social strategy, and audience engagement.


What you’ll do:

- Own daily posting across TikTok, IG Reels, YouTube Shorts, X, and more

- Turn podcast episodes into high-performing short-form content

- Decide what clips get posted, when, and where

- Manage comments, DMs, and community engagement across platforms

- Help shape the voice and presence of brands online

- Analyze performance and double down on what works


Key Responsibilities 1. Content Distribution & Posting
  • Own daily posting across all social platforms (TikTok, IG Reels, YouTube Shorts, X, etc.)
  • Manage scheduling, captions, hashtags, and formatting per platform
  • Ensure consistent, high-volume output of podcast clips
2. Podcast Clip Strategy
  • Turn long-form podcast episodes into a structured content distribution plan
  • Decide what clips get posted, when, and where
  • Collaborate with editors to guide clip selection and packaging (hooks, titles, formats)
3. Growth & Optimization
  • Analyze performance data to identify winning formats, topics, and hooks
  • Continuously iterate on posting strategy to increase:
  • Views
  • Engagement
  • Follower growth
  • A/B test captions, formats, and posting times
4. Platform Expertise
  • Stay on top of trends, algorithm changes, and best practices across platforms
  • Adapt content strategy accordingly (e.G., TikTok vs. Reels vs. Shorts nuances)
5. Systems & Organization
  • Build and manage a content calendar + distribution system
  • Track posted content and performance metrics
  • Ensure no content bottlenecks between editing → posting → reporting
6. Collaboration
  • Work closely with:
  • Editors (to refine clips)
  • Creators/clients (to align on voice and goals)
  • Leadership (to align on growth strategy)


What we’re looking for:

- Experience growing social accounts (especially short-form video)

- Strong understanding of TikTok / Reels / Shorts

- Someone who actually gets internet culture + audience behavior

- Ability to manage both content output + community interaction

Must-Haves
  • 2–4+ years managing social media accounts (preferably podcast or creator-led content)
  • Proven experience growing accounts through short-form video
  • Deep understanding of TikTok, Instagram Reels, and YouTube Shorts
  • Strong instincts for what makes content go viral
  • Experience managing high-volume posting (multiple posts/day)
  • Fluent in English - Speaking and Writing.
Nice-to-Haves
  • Experience working with podcasts or long-form content
  • Background in content editing or scripting
  • Familiarity with tools like:
  • Asana/ Slack
  • Social schedulers (Later, Hootsuite, etc.)
  • Analytics tools
  • Experience managing multiple brands or clients
Bonus:

- Experience with podcasts or creator-led brands

- Background in content editing or scripting

- Experience building or managing online communities

This is a high-impact role with real ownership across content, distribution, and community.

title: Senior Automation Analyst
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Senior Automation Analyst em salvador. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

Quem Somos

A Dexian, lançada em 2023, tem presença global e traz consigo quase 30 anos de experiência através de suas companhias legadas, principalmente da combinação da DISYS e Signature Consultants.


Iniciamos no Brasil 2007 como DISYS e, de lá para cá, conquistamos mais de 50 clientes de diferentes setores da economia. Como Dexian, passamos a ser uma das maiores empresas de contratação e solução de TI e estamos liderando a indústria por meio de entrega de serviços exclusivos que combina escala global, recursos de serviço completo e agilidade tática para modernizar modelos de contratação, avançar em soluções de mão-de-obra e transformar a infraestrutura tecnológica. Contamos com escritórios estrategicamente localizados em quatro grandes capitais: Curitiba (PR), Porto Alegre (RS), Rio de Janeiro (RJ) e São Paulo (SP). Every year, the healthcare industry loses billions due to billing failures. We are building the missing link that closes this gap with AI.

title: Post Producer
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Post Producer em salvador. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

Post Producer

Location: Remote

Position Type: Contract

Company: Pocket FM



About Us

At Pocket FM, our mission is to deliver immersive storytelling experiences to a global audience. With a global audience of over 200 million listeners, we are redefining entertainment through episodic audio storytelling across diverse genres. We are seeking a highly organized and creative Creative Producer to manage and oversee the end-to-end production of high-quality audio content.

Role Overview

As a Creative Producer , you will play a key role in managing the end-to-end production process of audio content across various formats on Pocket FM. You will collaborate closely with writers, voice artists, creators, and production teams to ensure timely delivery of high-quality episodes. The role requires strong operational management, creative oversight, and the ability to coordinate across multiple stakeholders to deliver compelling audio experiences for our listeners.



Key Responsibilities

1. Post Production Operations Management

Oversee day-to-day post-production operations for ongoing audio shows and promotional adds, ensuring smooth workflows from raw audio to final delivery. Manage editing, sound design, mixing, and mastering pipelines to meet release schedules.

2. Post Production Team Coordination

Work closely with editors, sound designers, mixing engineers, and external post-production vendors to deliver high-quality audio content. Ensure clear briefs, efficient collaboration, and consistency across outputs.

3. Production Planning & Pipeline Management

Collaborate with content and production teams to plan post-production schedules, track weekly deliverables, and ensure timely completion of all episodes. Proactively identify and resolve bottlenecks in the pipeline.

4. Stakeholder Collaboration

Coordinate with cross-functional teams including Content, Marketing, Product, and Quality Control to align on timelines, creative requirements, and delivery standards.

5. Audio Quality & Finishing Oversight

Own the final quality of all audio outputs, including editing precision, sound design, mixing balance, mastering levels, and overall listening experience. Ensure all content meets defined technical and creative benchmarks before release.

6. Vendor & Partner Management

Build and manage a network of external studios, freelancers, and post-production partners to support scalable content production. Ensure quality, consistency, and timely delivery across partners.

7. Feedback Integration & Continuous Improvement

Monitor listener feedback and internal QC inputs to identify issues related to audio clarity, pacing, sound design, or technical quality. Drive improvements across post-production processes.

8. Process & Workflow Optimization

Continuously enhance post-production workflows, tools, and standards to improve efficiency, scalability, and output quality. Document best practices, templates, and guidelines for consistent execution.

9. Volume & Deadline Management

Manage high-volume content pipelines across multiple shows, ensuring all deadlines are met without compromising on audio quality or production standards.

10. Quality Control Training & Creative Alignment

Continuously train and support QC team members responsible for assigned shows to ensure strong alignment on creative direction, audio quality standards, storytelling expectations, and technical benchmarks. Work closely with QC specialists on a weekly basis to review content, calibrate feedback, identify recurring issues, and maintain consistency across shows and post-production outputs.


11. Internal Promotional Video Post-Production Leadership

Lead the internal post-production team for promotional video assets, aligning editors, sound designers, and mixers around consistent quality standards, sonic identity, creative style, and delivery expectations. Ensure all promotional videos maintain a cohesive audio language, polished sound design, and production value aligned with brand and marketing objectives.

12. AI-driven Innovations and tool adotion

Leverage AI-powered tools and emerging technologies across editing, sound design, voice processing, mixing, mastering, QC, and workflow automation to improve efficiency, scalability, and creative quality. Stay updated on evolving AI trends in post-production and evaluate new tools/workflows that enhance turnaround time, consistency, audio quality, and overall production effectiveness while maintaining strong creative and editorial standards.



Qualifications

  • 7+ years of experience in post-production, audio production, or media production, with a strong focus on editing, sound design, and final delivery workflows.
  • Solid understanding of audio storytelling and hands-on experience across post-production stages, including editing, mixing, mastering, and finishing for podcasts or audiobooks.
  • Proven experience working with post-production teams such as editors, sound designers, mixing engineers, or external production vendors.
  • Strong project management and organizational skills, with the ability to manage multiple post-production pipelines and deadlines simultaneously.
  • Effective stakeholder management and communication skills, with experience collaborating across content, production, and quality teams.
  • Ability to operate in fast-paced, high-volume production environments while maintaining consistent quality standards.
  • Self-driven with strong problem-solving capabilities and a proactive approach to identifying and resolving production challenges.
